Title: Lead - Retention and Engagement
Industry: Entertainment Providers, Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, and Technology, Information and Media
Description:
**Position Summary:**

The Lead, Retention and Engagement is responsible for developing and executing TOD’s customer retention, engagement, and subscriber lifecycle strategy across MENA, with the objective of reducing churn, improving renewal and reactivation rates, increasing customer engagement, and maximizing subscriber lifetime value.

The role will lead data-driven retention and lifecycle initiatives across the full customer journey, from onboarding and active engagement through renewal, churn prevention, win-back, and reactivation. Working closely with Marketing, CRM, Product, Customer Care, Analytics, Commercial, Content, Technology, and Finance, the role will identify subscriber behavior and churn drivers, develop targeted customer segments and interventions, and continuously optimize customer engagement and loyalty.

The position will also oversee the planning and execution of personalized, multi-channel lifecycle campaigns, ensuring that customer insights, content preferences, sports calendars, viewing behavior, subscription data, and commercial objectives are translated into relevant and measurable retention initiatives.

The role is accountable for monitoring key retention KPIs, including churn, renewal, reactivation, engagement, customer lifetime value, and campaign performance, and for providing actionable recommendations to improve subscriber value and long-term loyalty.

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

**Retention Strategy & Subscriber Lifecycle**

* Develop and lead TOD’s customer retention and lifecycle strategy across MENA markets.
* Define retention priorities, initiatives, and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, renewal, churn prevention, cancellation, and win-back stages.
* Identify key churn drivers and develop targeted initiatives to improve subscriber retention and loyalty.
* Build differentiated retention strategies for various customer segments, subscription types, markets, and customer value groups.
* Develop initiatives aimed at increasing subscription tenure, renewal rates, engagement, and customer lifetime value.
* Partner with relevant teams to develop proactive and reactive churn-prevention programs.
* Lead and align the retention strategy across Sports and Entertainment subscriber segments, ensuring differentiated approaches based on content consumption, customer behavior, seasonality, and commercial priorities.
* Develop retention plans around major sports tournaments, premium entertainment releases, and key content moments to maximize subscriber engagement and minimize post-event churn.

**CRM & Lifecycle Campaigns**

* Lead the planning, execution, and continuous optimization of CRM and lifecycle campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, SMS, WhatsApp, and other approved customer communication channels.
* Develop personalized customer journeys based on subscriber behavior, viewing and content consumption patterns, engagement, payment status, tenure, and predicted churn risk.
* Establish automated lifecycle journeys including onboarding, activation, engagement, renewal reminders, payment recovery, churn prevention, and win-back.
* Ensure appropriate customer segmentation and personalization to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Drive continuous A/B testing and optimization of retention communications, offers, messaging, timing, and channels.
* Ensure lifecycle communications comply with customer consent, data privacy, communication governance, and brand guidelines across MENA markets.

**Churn Management & Win-Back**

* Monitor voluntary and involuntary churn and develop strategies to reduce both.
* Design cancellation journeys and save strategies aimed at retaining customers before subscription termination.
* Develop effective win-back programs for former subscribers.
* Work with Product, Payment, Technology, and Customer Care teams to address payment failures and other causes of involuntary churn.
* Develop and recommend targeted retention offers, incentives, pricing interventions, and product propositions based on customer behavior, churn risk, customer lifetime value, and commercial viability.
* Ensure retention activities balance subscriber growth with revenue and profitability objectives.

**Data, Analytics & Performance**

* Define and monitor key retention KPIs including churn rate, renewal rate, retention rate, engagement, reactivation, customer lifetime value, campaign conversion, and subscription tenure.
* Partner closely with Data and Analytics teams to develop customer segmentation, churn prediction models, cohort analysis, and subscriber behavior insights.
* Use customer behavior, cohort analysis, churn signals, and content consumption data to identify retention opportunities, develop targeted interventions, and measure incremental customer lifetime value.
* Translate customer data and behavioral insights into actionable retention initiatives.
* Develop dashboards and regular performance reporting to track retention performance and campaign effectiveness.
* Conduct cohort and funnel analysis to identify critical points of subscriber drop-off.
* Measure incremental impact and ROI of retention initiatives.
* Establish test-and-learn frameworks to measure the incremental impact of retention initiatives and identify scalable best practices.
* Partner with Analytics teams to improve churn propensity modelling, customer lifetime value modelling, and next-best-action capabilities.

**Customer Experience & Engagement**

* Work closely with Product, Content, and Customer Care teams to identify opportunities to improve the overall subscriber experience.
* Use customer feedback, behavioral data, contact-center insights, cancellation reasons, and engagement data to identify areas affecting subscriber satisfaction and retention.
* Develop engagement initiatives around key sports, entertainment, and content moments to maximize active usage and subscriber loyalty.
* Support personalization and recommendation initiatives aimed at increasing customer engagement.
* Ensure retention strategies reflect differences in customer behavior and preferences across MENA markets.
* Define and implement subscriber engagement strategies designed to increase platform usage, content discovery, viewing frequency, and overall customer stickiness.
* Develop engagement programs tailored to different customer segments, content preferences, and stages of the subscriber lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to increase engagement among low-activity or at-risk subscribers before they enter the cancellation journey.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Marketing, Product, Commercial, Content, Customer Care, Technology, Finance, and Analytics teams to deliver retention initiatives.
* Work with Customer Care teams to establish appropriate save offers, cancellation handling procedures, and retention scripts.
* Collaborate with Product and Technology teams to improve subscriber journeys, cancellation flows, payment journeys, and customer engagement features.
* Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to assess the financial impact of retention offers and initiatives.
* Coordinate with acquisition teams to ensure customer quality, retention performance, and lifetime value are considered alongside subscriber acquisition.
* Partner with Content teams to align retention and engagement activity with major sports rights, tournaments, entertainment launches, and content calendars.

**Planning & Leadership**

* Own the retention roadmap and ensure timely execution of agreed initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Retention and Engagement team, setting clear objectives, accountabilities, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective workload allocation and collaboration between Sports Retention and Entertainment Retention specialists.
* Build team capability in CRM, lifecycle marketing, analytics, experimentation, and customer engagement best practices Establish clear operating processes, campaign calendars, governance, and reporting.
* Manage relevant agencies, CRM and technology vendors, and external partners while maintaining strong internal ownership of retention strategy, delivery, measurement, and critical CRM capabilities.
* Stay informed of developments in OTT, subscription businesses, CRM, customer lifecycle management, personalization, and retention best practices.
* Present retention performance, key insights, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

**Job Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Analytics, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in CRM, Digital Marketing, Customer Analytics, or related disciplines is advantageous.

**Experience:**

* Typically, 8 years of relevant experience in customer retention, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer growth, subscription management, or digital marketing.
* Experience within OTT, streaming, publishing, subscription apps, digital memberships, telecommunications, digital platforms, media, entertainment, e-commerce, or other subscription-based businesses is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, specialists, or major cross-functional retention and CRM initiatives.
* Strong understanding of subscription economics, churn management, customer lifetime value, and customer engagement.
* Proven hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing automated lifecycle journeys using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Insider, Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or equivalent.
* Strong experience working with customer segmentation, behavioral data, campaign analytics, and performance measurement.
* Experience working across multiple markets, preferably within the MENA region.
* Previous team leadership or project leadership experience is preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, customer data, and lifecycle management platforms.
* Demonstrated experience translating customer analytics and behavioral insights into measurable commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing retention strategies across multiple customer segments, products, or content propositions.
* Strong commercial understanding of subscription models, pricing, promotional offers, and customer lifetime value.

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Description:
Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.
  
  
**Key competencies**

* Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership
* Calm, structured coordination during incidents and escalations
* Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
* Influence and negotiation without direct authority
* Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting

**Key Responsibilities**

* Single point of contact: Serve as the primary interface with Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security issues, requests and dependencies
* Incident and escalation coordination: Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths
* Change and dependency coordination: Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels
* Security and access requests: Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion
* Engagement model: Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities
* Governance and reporting: Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director

**Requirements**
**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
* Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
* Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
* Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
* Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries

**Key Technical Skills**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable

Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

‎
  
  
The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. The role establishes the monitoring, operational controls and support practices needed to run AI services effectively in production and provides visibility into agent and model behavior, platform performance and emerging operational risks. The role works closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance and technology teams to ensure AI platforms operate within established enterprise standards and guardrails.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications across Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio or AI are considered assets.

The placement within the range is determined by the range of market pay for the specific position, as well as the candidate's knowledge, skillset and experience relative to the requirements of the position and to internal peers. Zebra's Wearable Solutions business unit focuses on developing compact, small form factored wearables products and advanced AI solutions that runs on these devices to enable enterprise customers run their operations with increased productivity.
  
  
Our technical and solutions program management team is responsible for leading a cross-functional team of Systems, Hardware, Firmware and Software Engineers, Test Engineers, Supply chain Operations, etc. from initial concept to deployment.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Zebra Technologies.
  
  

* Works independently with business in defining proof of value and customer’s return on investment.
* Explores and understands competitive landscape in both product and business terms. Defines strategic initiatives to align the business to agile product development.

* Drives execution of solutions inclusive of concept definition, requirements validation, architecture specification, and governance compliance to our Application Lifecycle Management framework.

* Establishes standards of performance across programs that are typically complex in nature with cross-functional teams in numerous locations and time zones.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives to improve quality, increase efficiency and accelerate time to market.
* Leads system integration planning, release management, and planning for demonstrations, proof of concepts and pilots.
* Leads creating cross functional workstreams and driving execution for sales enablement, development and deployment.
* Independently builds relationships and working across all relevant areas of the solution business including Sales, Services, IT, Finance, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Support.
* Organizes and presents business, technical and program reviews/status to Senior Leadership using digital media and dashboards.
* Recognized as an "expert" in the business function and processes in which the program is operating.
* Motivates teams to ensure solutions are reliable and of quality, in a highly collaborative fashion.
* Independently coordinates deliverables and project assets to assist the project team.
* Personally anticipates and addresses obstacles or issues that are moderate to significant in severity and escalates complex issues to management for assistance. Independently engages additional resources as needed to address obstacles or delays.
* Adjusts the plan per management guidelines as delays or obstacles are experienced.
* Demonstrates advanced understanding of development processes and product launch scope and activities
* Demonstrates strength in hiring, recruiting, managing, developing, coaching, and retaining individuals and teams.
* Partners with Zebra Ventures to identify entities that are added-value to your business and solutions.
* Develops and protects intellectual property; is well versed with IP fundamentals.

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or STEM degree required
* Minimum 12 years' Engineering/Technical Program management and Scrum Master experience for products in fast paced environment, including minimum 2 years as team supervisor / manager.
* Must have experience with small form factored hardware product development for consumer or enterprise customers (such as wearable computers, barcode ring scanners, Headphones, IoT devices etc.)

Title: Senior Security Manager, Assistance

Description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior Security Manager, Assistance**
to lead our regional Security Assistance team, based in Dubai.
  
  
This is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the delivery of frontline security assistance services across Mashreq, Iran, East and Southern Africa. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational leadership, ensuring the delivery of high-quality security advice, case management, incident response, crisis support and preventative security services to our clients and members.
  
  
Working closely with the Global Security Director, Assistance, Regional Operations Directors and wider global security network, you will drive operational excellence, strengthen regional capabilities and ensure consistent service delivery in line with International SOS standards and client expectations.
  
  
You will also play an important role in developing regional security talent, supporting business growth, strengthening client relationships and maintaining operational readiness in an evolving security environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Management and Leadership**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Security Managers, Security Specialists and associated security personnel across the region.
* Lead, coach and develop regional security teams, promoting professional growth, engagement and high performance.
* Oversee performance management, objective setting, succession planning and workforce development.
* Ensure effective resource planning and allocation to meet operational demands and client requirements.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, operational excellence and customer focus.
* Lead the Security Case Lead function in coordination with Security Managers.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training and retention of regional security personnel.
* Act as deputy to the Global Security Director, Assistance, in the Middle East region.

**Core Client & Internal Support**

* Oversee the delivery of regional security assistance services, ensuring timely, effective and customer-focused outcomes.
* Provide expert security guidance and support to clients, travellers, expatriates and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain oversight of security case management and ensure consistent service quality and operational standards.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex security cases, incidents and operational challenges.
* Coordinate security responses to emergencies, critical incidents and crisis situations.
* Monitor regional security developments and ensure operational responses reflect current threat assessments and intelligence.
* Provide senior-level review and quality assurance of security advice, assessments and recommendations.
* Maintain regional operational preparedness plans, procedures and response protocols.
* Oversee regional security provider networks, partnerships and the Secure Hotel Programme.
* Support Incident Management Teams and Crisis Management Teams during major incidents and events.
* Promote effective collaboration across Medical, Operations, Travel, Aviation, Network Services and Intelligence & Analysis teams.

**Consulting Delivery & Sales, Marketing Support**

* Deliver high-quality security consulting services in line with client requirements.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of security risk assessments, country assessments, travel security programmes and tailored client solutions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, workshops and business development engagements.
* Deliver security briefings, webinars, training programmes and awareness sessions.
* Support the preparation of proposals, tenders and commercial opportunities.
* Contribute to client retention through expert advice and excellent service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing services and develop new client value propositions.
* Represent International SOS at relevant industry events, conferences and stakeholder meetings.
* Support regional commercial objectives through security expertise and operational insight

**Required Experience & Skills**

* At least 8 years of experience in security operations and planning, including operational deployment in hostile and/or challenging environments.
* Experience gained within private security companies, military, NGOs, government or relevant private-sector organisations, ideally within the Middle East.
* Proven experience in leading and managing security teams, including remote or hybrid teams.
* Strong experience in planning and managing security assistance operations.
* Extensive knowledge of security risk management principles and best practices across diverse risk environments.
* Strong understanding of the political, security and threat landscape across the Middle East and wider region.
* Experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Ability to analyse complex security, logistical and threat-related information and translate findings into clear recommendations and action plans.
* Experience preparing reports and providing advice to senior management and decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-cultural collaboration skills.
* Strong IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

**Desirable Experience**

* Crisis management and emergency response experience.
* Security consulting and training delivery.
* Client-facing presentations, public speaking and media engagement.
* Business development and commercial support.
* Quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications & Education**

* Degree-level education in Security Studies, Conflict Studies, International Politics, International Relations or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience.
* Accreditation or membership with a recognised regional security or risk management professional body is desirable.

**Languages**

* Excellent written and spoken English is essential.
* Arabic, French or another European language would be an advantage.

**Why Join International SOS?**
Join a global organisation where your expertise can make a meaningful difference in protecting people and supporting organisations operating in complex environments.
  
  
At International SOS, you will work alongside experienced professionals across a global network, contribute to critical security operations and help deliver services that protect the health, safety and security of people worldwide.
  
  
**If you are an experienced security leader looking for an opportunity to make an impact on a regional and global scale, we would like to hear from you.**

The Senior Manager, IT Operations, is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the CIB’s IT function. Reporting to the VP, IT, this role ensures reliable service delivery, effective vendor and managed service partner performance, disciplined ITSM practices, and strong operational controls across infrastructure, service desk, cybersecurity operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity. * Develop, maintain, and improve ITSM processes, procedures, and operating standards that support reliable, secure, and efficient technology services
* Define, monitor, and report on service-level objectives, operational metrics, risks, and recurring issues

* Support the ongoing development and execution of the IT roadmap by identifying operational improvements, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements
* Maintain and improve cybersecurity controls and operational security practices, including oversight of vulnerability management, penetration testing, awareness training, and remediation tracking

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, infrastructure, service delivery, or related technology roles
* Experience leading IT operations in a structured, risk-conscious environment, preferably in financial services, investments, asset management, or a comparable sector

Title: Global Travel Operations & Transformation Manager
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Global Travel Operations & Transformation drives operations and traveler support, ensure consistent service delivery while advancing technology and program transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Travel, this role translates program strategy into scalable operational programs, technology enhancements, and measurable outcomes for a global workforce.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role responsible for managing traveler support, resolving complex issues and escalations, monitoring TMC and supplier performance, and ensuring changes are successfully implemented across the global platform.
  
  
This leader manages day-to-day program performance, advances transformation initiatives, and brings forward emerging capabilities that can improve how employees plan, book, and experience business travel. The ideal candidate is proactive, data-driven, service-oriented, and energized by learning, testing, and embracing new technology, including artificial intelligence and automation. Success requires balancing traveler experience, cost stewardship, policy compliance, duty of care, and operational efficiency while consistently delivering best-in-class service at a global scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Global Travel Operations & Service Excellence
  
  

* Manage and continuously improve global travel operations, ensuring reliable, consistent, and traveler-centered service across regions and time zones
* Oversee traveler support, case triage, escalations, service recovery, and issue resolution, with clear accountability and follow-through
* Identify recurring traveler pain points and implement preventive, scalable solutions through knowledge content, process improvements, self-service, and technology
* Monitor program performance, traveler feedback, service levels, and operational trends to proactively address risks and opportunities
* Balance employee experience, cost effectiveness, policy compliance, and duty of care in operational decisions

Program Transformation, Technology & AI
  
  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Global Travel, to execute the future vision for travel services at Equinix
* Lead transformation initiatives that modernize travel processes, improve the online booking experience, and create simpler, more intuitive traveler journeys
* Identify, evaluate, and help implement emerging technology, artificial intelligence, automation, predictive analytics, and self-service capabilities that improve traveler support and program efficiency
* Build practical use cases for AI and new technology, support responsible adoption, and measure impact on service quality, productivity, and traveler experience
* Stay current on corporate travel trends and digital capabilities, bringing forward recommendations that support continuous program evolution
* Promote a learning mindset by testing new approaches, applying lessons quickly, and helping stakeholders embrace change

Supplier & Service Delivery Management
  
  

* Manage operational relationships with the travel management company and other travel service providers, including performance reviews, escalations, service-level accountability, and continuous improvement
* Use scorecards, service data, traveler feedback, and root-cause analysis to strengthen supplier performance and drive sustainable solutions
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners on program changes, implementations, testing, and adoption

Data, Insights & Executive Communication
  
  

* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into travel spend, booking behavior, online booking adoption, service performance, policy compliance, and traveler experience
* Translate complex data into concise insights, recommendations, and action plans for leaders and global stakeholders
* Create executive-ready presentations and business reviews that clearly communicate performance, risks, opportunities, decisions, and outcomes
* Improve data quality and reporting discipline to strengthen business decisions and program governance

Global Collaboration & Change Leadership
  
  

* Partner across Corporate Security, Finance, Procurement, HR, Events, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver a cohesive global travel experience
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workplans, operating rhythms, communications, and measurable deliverables
* Lead change management and traveler communications for policy, process, supplier, and technology changes. Influence stakeholders across a matrixed global organization, driving alignment while balancing enterprise standards with local market requirements
* Serve as a thought partner to the Senior Manager, Global Travel by surfacing emerging trends, operational insights, and innovation opportunities

**Qualifications**

* Proven years of progressive experience in corporate travel, travel operations, travel technology, employee services, supplier management, or related field
* Experience managing complex programs or operations across multiple countries or regions
* Demonstrated success leading operational improvements, technology implementations, or transformation initiatives
* Experience managing online booking tools, travel technologies, digital platforms, or service providers
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience using data to identify opportunities and drive action
* Excellent program management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment
* Experience supporting a large global workforce and delivering services across multiple regions and time zones
* Experience with artificial intelligence, automation, self-service, predictive analytics, or other emerging technology capabilities
* Experience developing dashboards, operational scorecards, and executive reporting
* Knowledge of travel policy governance, duty of care, travel risk management, and global travel industry practices
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, performance metrics, and service-level commitments
* Experience with user acceptance testing, requirements gathering, documentation, communications, and change management

Description:

Lead the strategy, delivery, governance, and operational excellence of the technology platforms that power engineering applications around the world. In this leadership role, you will shape secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective environments across application hosting, cloud and vendor-hosted platforms, virtual desktop infrastructure, data governance, automation, and future-ready engineering technologies. Working across Client Delivery Solutions, Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Data & AI, and Engineering, you will help project teams and engineering professionals deliver at their best while preparing WSP for what comes next.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Shape engineering platform strategy and operations: Define and govern the technology platform strategy supporting global engineering applications. Ensure operational readiness, availability, performance, resilience, scalability, and security across engineering technology environments. Establish platform standards, technical governance frameworks, service operating procedures, lifecycle plans, and modernization initiatives.
* Advance virtual desktop infrastructure and engineering computing: Own the strategy and roadmap for engineering VDI and remote computing environments. Partner with Infrastructure teams to optimize performance, user experience, graphics acceleration, and engineering workloads. Define standards for engineering workstations, cloud workstations, and hybrid delivery models, while evaluating future engineering computing technologies and deployment approaches.
* Govern demand delivery and resources: Oversee the intake, prioritization, and delivery of engineering technology initiatives. Manage resource allocation, team capacity planning, and delivery priorities. Partner with CDS Front Door, PMO, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to execute platform initiatives successfully, while monitoring delivery performance, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

Establish strategies for retention, archiving, recovery, compliance, business continuity, and long-term accessibility. Develop technology roadmaps supporting evolving engineering delivery models. Drive workforce planning, capability development, upskilling, and succession planning. Establish governance and engagement models for business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams, fostering accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Education and enterprise platform leadership: A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, combined with significant experience managing enterprise platforms, infrastructure services, cloud technologies, or engineering application environments.

* Data governance depth: A strong understanding of data governance, retention, archiving, recovery, and information lifecycle management practices, along with knowledge of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and data governance frameworks.
* Complex delivery leadership: Experience managing technical delivery portfolios and complex cross-functional initiatives using ITIL, Agile, SAFe, or comparable delivery methodologies.
* Global leadership and operating-model experience: Experience leading global technical teams and driving operating-model transformation, capability development, workforce planning, and organizational change.
* Financial and investment acumen: Strong financial management and technology investment experience, including budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment recommendations, and cost-optimization initiatives.
* Cloud-modernization capability: Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architectures, DaaS and VDI platforms, infrastructure modernization, cloud transformation, and enterprise platform-modernization initiatives.
* Executive influence and communication: Excellent stakeholder-management, executive-communication, presentation, written, and spoken English skills, with the ability to influence decisions across technical, operational, and business groups.

They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.

  

**WHY THIS ROLE**

You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.

Title: Digital Operations Lead - YuCOS
Description:

The Digital Operations Lead owns the rollout of YuCos, our collections technology platform, across the call centre, and runs the digital channels (starting with email campaigns) that sit on top of it.

**Role purpose**

YuCos is the platform our collections teams work in every day. This role makes sure it is implemented properly inside the call centre, adopted by agents and team leaders, and used to run digital outreach such as email campaigns, sms, conversational bots, and IVR. You are the single owner linking collections operations, technology and digital communication.

* **Location:**

* Run user acceptance testing, training and floor support; build user guides and SOPs.

* Manage audience segmentation, templates, sending cadence and suppression and opt-out lists.
* Test and optimize campaigns (subject lines, timing, content) using open, click, contact and payment-conversion data.
* Coordinate with call centre teams so digital and voice outreach support each other and do not duplicate contact.
* Extend digital operations to other channels (SMS, WhatsApp, payment links) as the business requires.

**Governance, reporting and compliance**

* Ensure campaigns and platform use follow regulatory, data-protection and collections-conduct requirements.
* Own reporting on campaign performance, platform usage and operational KPIs; present insights to management.
* Maintain change control, access management and documentation for YuCos in operations.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, operations or a related field.
* 5+ years in call centre, collections or contact-centre operations, with at least 2 years leading system implementations or digital projects.
* Hands-on experience with collections or CRM platforms, and with email campaign tools (segmentation, templates, deliverability, analytics).
* Strong process-mapping and requirements skills; able to turn operational needs into clear system specifications.
* Comfortable with data: reporting, dashboards, and A/B testing; advanced Excel, with SQL or BI tools a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management across operations, technology, compliance and vendors.
* Clear communicator and trainer who can coach frontline teams through change.

**Preferred**

* Experience in lending, banking or financial-services collections.
* Knowledge of data-protection and collections-conduct regulations in the region.
* Exposure to SMS, WhatsApp or omnichannel communication tools.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile).
* Strong English language skills. Knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Title: Senior Manager - QA & Site Co-ordination - AA9
Description:
Lead the independent quality assurance and site co-ordination function for City Ops ICT assets throughout the project lifecycle. Establish and operate consistent quality controls, stage-gate checkpoints, inspection and testing arrangements, and evidence-based validation of operational requirements before handover and service transition. Maintain objective oversight of gaps, defects and remediation, while keeping delivery accountability with the relevant project, contractor, vendor or asset owner. Set the strategic QA direction, lead the assurance team and provide senior management with independent recommendations on quality, readiness and residual risk.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independent, evidence-based judgement and challenge of incomplete readiness evidence
* Senior leadership of QA/QC governance, quality strategy, risk prioritisation and structured issue escalation
* Clear stakeholder communication, cross-vendor co-ordination and executive, audit-ready reporting
* Ability to direct field verification teams and manage site access, safety and inspection logistics
* Portfolio-level prioritisation, resource planning, supplier performance oversight and continuous improvement
* QA Governance & Independence
* Own and maintain the City Ops ICT QA/QC and gap-assessment framework, including standards, workflows, evidence requirements, severity classification, validation, prioritisation, closure and reporting.
* Define QA checkpoints, sign-off criteria, Site Inspection Plans, asset-specific checklists, test scripts, hold / witness points and acceptance evidence standards.
* Provide independent assessment of operational readiness and quality, separate from project delivery accountability; challenge incomplete or disputed evidence and escalate material acceptance risks.
* Lead the QA team, including field / testing and domain verification resources, and apply consistent methods across sites and packages.
* Set portfolio QA priorities, allocate assurance resources and provide senior leadership with independent recommendations on systemic quality risks and readiness.

* Site Co-ordination, Inspection & Testing
* Plan and co-ordinate site access, inspections, permits, inductions, vendor attendance, equipment and documentation for site verification activities.
* Direct and quality-assure document reviews, physical inspections, interviews and functional testing performed by Field and Test Engineers.
* Co-ordinate physical and functional verification of ICT infrastructure and systems, including cabling / fibre, switches, equipment rooms, CCTV / VMS, access control, UPS and associated power arrangements.
* Ensure inspection records contain checklists, photos, test results, calibration and safety evidence, with a clear pass, gap or not-applicable outcome.
* Operational Readiness & Handover Assurance
* Translate approved service, support, monitoring, resilience, cybersecurity, lifecycle and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* Validate readiness evidence, test and commissioning results, as-built and configuration records, asset information, licences, warranties, training, O&M documentation and support arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based recommendation on handover readiness, documenting exceptions, residual risks, conditional acceptance and corrective actions; do not replace the authorised acceptance decision-maker.
* Confirm outstanding defects, vendor obligations and support information are transferred into the appropriate QTech ITSM / ServiceNow and operational governance processes.
* Issue Management, Reporting & Escalation
* Own and maintain the Master Gap Register, Defect / Snag Register and Remediation Tracker as controlled, traceable records.
* Validate findings for evidence sufficiency, severity, ownership and corrective action; track target dates and verify objective closure evidence.
* Escalate critical / high findings, disputed classifications, safety concerns and unresolved readiness risks through agreed governance channels.
* Prepare dashboards, executive summaries and decision-ready reporting on quality status, ageing, dependencies, closure trends and handover risks; lead root-cause reviews and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder & Team Co-ordination
* Co-ordinate inspections, validation workshops and readiness reviews with City Ops ICT, QTech, MDU / EBU, Districts, Cybersecurity, vendors, contractors and service integrators.
* Provide leadership, work direction and coaching to field / test engineers and support consistent technical and audit-ready quality records.
* Hold delivery partners accountable for evidence quality and remediation commitments while preserving independent assurance boundaries.
* Seven Stage-Gate Quality Checkpoints
* CP1 - Understand Project Scope: Confirm asset / system scope, site constraints, applicable standards, stakeholders and QA approach.
* CP2 - Define City ICT Operations Requirements: Translate operational, service and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* CP3 - Review Procurement Packages: Review RFPs, BoQs and specifications for inspection, testing, handover, support and evidence provisions.
* CP4 - Review Material Submissions: Review technical / material submissions, methods and test plans; flag deviations and lifecycle impacts.
* CP5 - Verify Delivered Requirements: Witness inspections and tests, validate as-built / configuration evidence and track defects to closure.
* CP6 - Support Handover Acceptance: Review handover packs and readiness evidence; recommend acceptance, exceptions and corrective actions.
* CP7 - Service Management Transition: Confirm quality records, support procedures and open obligations are transferred into operational governance.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or a related discipline.

**Professional Certifications**

Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

**Skills**

* ICT QA/QC governance, inspection / test planning, stage-gate assurance and evidence-based acceptance.
* Practical understanding of ICT infrastructure, smart-city and physical-security systems, commissioning, operational readiness and service transition.
* Defect and gap classification, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, registers, dashboards and audit-ready reporting.
* Site safety, permit-to-work, field inspection co-ordination, cross-vendor dependencies and stakeholder management.
* Independent judgement, clear escalation, strong written reporting and the ability to challenge incomplete evidence constructively.
* Experience leading gap / defect registers, site inspection programmes, acceptance criteria and management reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or related discipline.
* Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

Title: Director, Information Services
Location: Toronto, ON, Canada | Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Description:
***Get started on an exciting career at Element!***
---------------------------------------------------

Element employees make a difference in the lives of others every day. We are re-defining the fleet management industry to be people first, then business – delivering on our promise of a superior client experience. This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.

*Lead security services that protect our business, strengthen client trust, and enable growth.*

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------

At Element Fleet Management, we're looking for a Director of Services to lead our Information Security Services organization. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you'll oversee five critical service lines, ensuring security expertise is embedded early in business decisions, projects, and client engagements.

You'll shape a scalable security services model, lead a multidisciplinary team, and deliver consistent, high-quality services that reduce risk while supporting business priorities and client commitments.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
---------------------

* **Third-Party Risk:** Lead the third-party risk program, including policies, vendor assessments, risk ratings, risk acceptance, and security reviews of vendor and client contracts.
* **Security Architecture and Engineering:** Oversee security reviews of applications, cloud environments, integrations, and data flows. Establish secure design standards and reference architectures.
* **Security Advisory and Risk:** Provide security guidance from project initiation, manage the risk register and exception process, and lead escalations involving high-risk matters.
* **Client Security Response:** Oversee responses to client security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and audit inquiries, partnering with Sales, Legal, and Compliance.
* **Security Services Operations:** Establish centralized intake, prioritization, service-level tracking, and performance metrics. Own the services roadmap, budget, resources, and supporting technology.
* **Governance and Assurance:** Maintain alignment with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and NIST frameworks, supporting audit readiness and continuous improvement.

**YOU SHOULD CONSIDER THIS ROLE IF:**
-------------------------------------

  

* You bring 10+ years of experience in information security, risk management, or governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), including at least 4 years leading teams.
* You've successfully led a security services or advisory function spanning multiple disciplines.
* You have strong knowledge of security architecture, cloud security, and industry security frameworks.
* You have experience managing third-party risk programs and reviewing contractual security requirements.
* You're comfortable managing external partners and contractors, balancing service quality, scope, and cost.
* You combine strategic thinking with sound risk-based judgment and operational discipline.

Additional assets include a relevant degree, certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, or CTPRP, experience with GRC platforms and automation, or a background in a regulated or client-facing security environment.

**HOW YOU WILL LEAD**
---------------------

  

* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team across five security service lines.
* Establish clear accountabilities, service expectations, and performance measures.
* Foster collaboration across Technology, Legal, Procurement, Sales, and Compliance.
* Lead external advisors and assessment partners to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.
* Champion proactive security engagement, continuous improvement, and scalable service delivery.

**YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO TELL US**
---------------------------------

  

* How you've built or improved a security services function to deliver measurable business value.
* How you've balanced competing security priorities while maintaining service quality and managing risk.
* How you've influenced senior stakeholders to incorporate security earlier in business decisions.
* How you've developed teams, strengthened partnerships, and improved operational effectiveness.

**WHY ELEMENT**
---------------

At Element Fleet Management, security plays a critical role in enabling our business and maintaining client confidence.

Title: Regional Director
Description:
****ABOUT US****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:
  
  

* Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
* High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
* Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

****SUMMARY****
For the assigned region(s), the
**Regional Director**
is accountable for operations, financial management and meeting service delivery obligations in a specified Geographical region that includes several facilities, employees and clients.  This role is expected to understand, coach and train the team in all regulatory and client requirements.  In addition, this role is also responsible for contributing to strategic and account management plans and objectives and people leadership.
  
  
This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.
  
  
**Opportunities for Development:**
  
  
At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles.  Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:
  
  

* On Account and expanded Operational Leadership
* Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,
* Project Management leadership roles to lead and execute projects

****KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Health, Safety, Environment & Security**
  
  

* Follow and apply all Health and Safety and Emergency Response, aligned with both BGIS and Client expectations.to ensure safety of all employees and building occupants.
* Work in collaboration with BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams for support and direction on key programs to emphasize Safety Culture
* Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements
* Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed

**Account Management**
  
  

* Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services
* Provides input and contributes to the development and execution of strategic account expansion plans
* Recommends additional pull-through services
* Participates in and contributes to quarterly business reviews
* Contributes to contract renewal and business development activities
* Contributes to account governance
* Adherence to Contract Specific MSA (Master Service Agreement)
* Manages the BGIS ECE Program for the specific client group
* Responsible for results and action plans related to the Likely to Recommend Survey.

**Client Relationship Management**
  
  

* Accountable for achieving client satisfaction objectives for the assigned region(s)
* Accountable for developing and maintaining effective relationships with clients, managing client expectations
* Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level
* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

**Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management**
  
  

* Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management.
* In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.
* Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary.
* Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources.
* Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly
* Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings

**Portfolio Management**
  
  

* Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s)
* Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs
* Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans
* Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s)
* Provides input into strategic plans
* Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client.

**Service Delivery Management**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with Central Work Order Management Team to ensure all work is being completed as outlined in the MSA
* Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines.
* Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs.
* Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency.
* Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations.
* Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s)
* Oversees the delivery of all service obligations
* Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met.
* Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements

**Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution**
  
  

* Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution
* Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management

**Regulatory Compliance**
  
  

* Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained
* Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas

**Project Management**
  
  

* Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s)
* Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects
* Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s)

**Procurement**
  
  

* With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols
* Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services.

**Continuous Improvement**
  
  

* Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s)

**Leadership and Recognition**
  
  

* Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations
* Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores)
* Day to day support and team oversight/management

**Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios
* Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed

**Technology to Support your Success.**
  
  

* Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.
* Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships.
* Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression.
* Other duties as assigned

****KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS****

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience
* Highly skilled at account management
* Highly skilled at facility operations management
* Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
* Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
* Skilled at managing budgets
* Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
* High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
* Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
* Skilled at vendor management
* Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
* Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
* Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
* Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
* Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
* Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**
One or more of the following would be considered an asset:
  
  

* Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association
* Certified Property Manager from Institute of Real Estate Management
* Facility Management Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute
* Real Property Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $110,000 - $138,000 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager
Description:
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**

* Location: United States
* Work Arrangement: Remote (with limited travel)
* Employment Type: Full time

The
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**
oversees a complex portfolio of digital quality services for a strategic enterprise customer. Serving as the primary delivery connection point between customer stakeholders and the internal delivery organization, this role ensures testing programs are well-governed, properly resourced, measurable, and aligned with agreed business outcomes. The position leads a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs), collaborates with cross-functional internal teams, and partners closely with the customer's internal program owner while maintaining clear boundaries between service delivery and customer-owned responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Program and Service Delivery: Own the overall governance and delivery health of a multifaceted digital quality engagement. Translate customer objectives into executable service plans, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Manage deliverables, schedules, service levels, and testing coverage, anticipating delivery risks and capacity constraints to drive mitigation plans.

Monitor service performance through meaningful KPIs—such as quality trends, testing coverage, utilization, and outcomes—and deliver decision-ready reporting and quarterly business reviews.

Act as the central escalation point for delivery challenges, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder concerns.

Partner with Account Management on scope management and renewals, while documenting repeatable practices to reduce operational complexity.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in enterprise program delivery, implementation, consulting, managed services, or customer engagement leadership.
* Five or more years of technical program or service-delivery management experience within a digital product, software, testing, or technology-services environment.
* Experience overseeing multiple interdependent workstreams within a large enterprise engagement.
* Experience managing or leading distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Experience presenting program performance, risks, and business value to senior and executive stakeholders.
* Strong service-delivery and program-governance leadership in complex enterprise environments.

* Advanced program-management capabilities, including planning, scope management, capacity forecasting, risk mitigation, change management, and executive governance.
* Working knowledge of software testing, digital quality practices, and managed testing services.
* Familiarity with localization quality programs and globally distributed delivery models.
* Ability to translate technical and operational data into compelling business insights.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Strong judgment when navigating ambiguous ownership, competing stakeholder needs, or changing priorities.
* Ability to build trusted customer relationships while maintaining clear organizational and commercial boundaries.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, presentation tools, reporting platforms, and remote collaboration systems.
* A solutions-oriented approach with a strong commitment to customer, team, and delivery success.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with digital quality, crowdsourced testing, or testing-as-a-service models.
* Experience supporting global products or localization-related testing programs.
* Experience designing governance and reporting structures for complex strategic accounts.
* Experience leading a program through organizational transition or operating-model change.
