Title: Sr Service Manager – Digital Workplace & Field Services
Description:
**Details:**
**Job Title: Sr Service Manager - Digital Workplace & Field Services**
****Key Attributes To Feature In The Job Posting:****

* Technical Service Ownership of Modern Endpoint Services: Serve as the on-site single point of contact and technical service owner for endpoint management (SCCM/MECM, Intune, JAMF), M365 collaboration, Confluence, Citrix virtual workplace, and vulnerability management, accountable for SLAs and service health.
* Governance & Operational Readiness Leadership: Define and run ITIL-based governance (reporting, metrics, risk, controls, SOPs) across endpoint and Field Services, driving patch and vulnerability compliance, continuous improvement, automation, and AI-enabled service enhancements.

****Who We Are****
Founded in 1987, Stefanini helps midsize, large and global enterprises increase the efficiency of their IT operations while leveraging technology to empower their businesses. Our offerings include IT Infrastructure Outsourcing, End-User Computing, Application Managed Services, and Mainframe Modernization, with solutions spanning automation, cloud, IoT, UX, and AI alongside service desk, field service, and BPO. We have over 30,000 employees across 77 offices in 41 countries.
  
  
****Job Description****
This on-site Technical Service Manager role leads Modern Endpoint and Digital Workplace services for a key strategic client, combined with oversight of the Field Services teams and vendors that support the client's operations across multiple regions. You will be the single point of contact and technical service owner for endpoint management (SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, JAMF), M365 collaboration, Confluence, Citrix virtual workplace, and vulnerability management, ensuring operational readiness, security compliance, and an excellent end-user experience. In this blended role, you will connect technical service ownership with hands-on Field Services delivery, so that endpoint, collaboration, and security outcomes are carried out on the ground through on-site deskside support, hardware lifecycle, and site services. Working closely with client stakeholders, the Business Unit Leader, and the Client Success Director, you will drive program strategy, ensure operational readiness, own governance and service quality, and lead continuous improvement and innovation. This position requires strong attention to detail, technical breadth across the digital workplace, and excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Modern Endpoint & Digital Workplace Services**

* Serve as technical service owner for Modern Endpoint services across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices
* Oversee endpoint management platforms: SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune (including Autopilot and co-management), and JAMF for Apple devices
* Govern OS deployment, application packaging and distribution, patching, configuration baselines, and device compliance
* Oversee M365 collaboration services (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive) and Confluence/Atlassian collaboration platforms
* Manage Citrix Virtual Workplace (Virtual Apps and Desktops/VDI) service health, capacity, and user experience
* Own vulnerability management for the endpoint estate: drive remediation, patch SLAs, and compliance reporting with Security teams (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike, Defender)
* Align the client environment with the Microsoft Evergreen roadmap and plan platform upgrades and migrations (e.g., SCCM to Intune)
* Track endpoint KPIs (compliance, patch currency, deployment success, device health) and report to client leadership

**Field Services Delivery & On-Site Support**

* Lead on-site and regional Field Services teams delivering deskside support, break/fix, and IMAC (install, move, add, change) activities
* Oversee dispatch, ticket routing, and work-order management to meet response and resolution SLAs across sites
* Manage Tech Bar / walk-up support, smart lockers, loaner pools, and VIP / executive support services
* Coordinate hardware lifecycle: device provisioning, imaging, deployment, refresh, and secure disposal (including data sanitization)
* Govern IT asset management in the field: inventory accuracy, stockroom controls, and asset lifecycle tracking in the CMDB
* Lead site readiness for office openings, moves, closures, and large-scale refresh or migration projects
* Monitor field performance metrics (first-time fix rate, SLA attainment, backlog, CSAT) and drive corrective actions

**Integrating Field Services with Technical Service Management**

* Translate endpoint and security priorities into field execution plans (e.g., on-site remediation of non-compliant or unpatched devices)
* Use Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, and JAMF to enable zero-touch provisioning and reduce on-site effort and costs
* Coordinate Field Services with Service Desk, Endpoint Engineering, Security, and Citrix/VDI teams for seamless incident and change execution
* Use device health and monitoring data to plan proactive field visits and hardware replacement before failures occur
* Ensure field technicians are trained and certified on current endpoint platforms, tools, and SOPs
* Make sure field-driven changes follow change management and security controls
* Report combined endpoint and field service performance to client leadership in a single governance view

**Client Relationship & Service Delivery**

* Act as on-site Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the client and senior-level stakeholders
* Own day-to-day delivery of Field Services supporting the client's operations across multiple regions
* Set the strategic direction of the program and manage to scope of work and change of scope
* Be accountable for Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and other contractual deliverables
* Manage customer expectations; ensure clarity of delivery commitments and prioritize to maximize value
* Own, investigate, and follow up on high-level escalations
* Chair internal and client-facing service delivery meetings; develop and deliver management-level presentations

**Governance, Risk & Operational Readiness**

* Define and maintain ongoing governance: reporting, monitoring, escalation, and controls
* Design, implement, and monitor ITIL processes (incident, request, change, problem management)
* Manage issues and risks across all service components; maintain risk matrices, dependencies, and timelines
* Define and write policies, controls, and SOPs per client needs and oversee implementation
* Define objectives and metrics; collect and analyze data to guide decision-making
* Conduct ticket audits, negative survey follow-ups, and other quality initiatives
* Address bottlenecks and balance security and business needs against team or technology constraints

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Sponsor and drive improvement activities; mature internal processes so teams deliver early and often
* Champion innovation and transformation, including automation, AI, and IT health monitoring tools
* Lead focus groups to improve processes and procedures; implement best business practices
* Identify opportunities to expand service offerings and support new business opportunities

**Financial & Vendor Management**

* Manage program financials to budget
* Assist with monthly client invoices; reconcile and approve vendor invoices
* Secure and manage 3rd-party vendor resources

**People Leadership**

* Hire Stefanini employees; establish expectations and provide leadership, direction, and coaching
* Drive cross-team efforts; remove impediments and shield teams from external interruptions
* Conduct one-on-ones and performance reviews; leverage recognition programs
* Create a cohesive team environment through consistent management
* Aid in corporate initiatives and perform other duties as assigned

Job Requirements
  
  
**Details:**
**Requirements**

* 7+ years of professional IT experience, including technical service management of Modern Endpoint and Digital Workplace services
* Hands-on or service-ownership experience with SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, and JAMF
* Experience supporting M365 collaboration, Confluence, and Citrix virtual workplace environments
* Experience running vulnerability management and patch compliance programs for endpoint environments
* 5+ years managing Field Services teams, including deskside support, dispatch, IMAC, and hardware lifecycle
* Experience managing multi-site field operations and third-party field vendors to SLAs
* Familiarity with ITSM and field service tools (e.g., ServiceNow, CMDB, asset management systems)
* Experience managing teams supporting multi-region or multi-country operations is a plus
* Experience designing, implementing, and running ITIL core processes
* Financial management experience (budgets, invoicing, vendor reconciliation)
* In-depth understanding of IT industry dynamics and service delivery processes
* Knowledge of security and governance frameworks (ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL, COBIT); ability to communicate IT risk to business and technical audiences
* Willingness to embrace innovative tools such as AI, automation, and IT health monitoring
* Critical thinking, problem-solving, and prioritization skills; calm and effective under pressure and ambiguity
* Superior verbal, written, and presentation skills; proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
* Ability to manage strategically and at a detailed level; high integrity with confidential matters
* Valid driver's license required

**Technical Competencies (General Understanding)**

* Windows and Linux operating environments
* Virtualization and infrastructure (VMware, Citrix, NetApp, Rubrik, Azure File Sync)
* Networking and network security (Cisco, Fortinet, DNS, load balancing)
* Security tools (Splunk SIEM, CrowdStrike EDR, AV, firewalls) and IAM (Active Directory, Archer GRC)
* Hybrid cloud (Azure) monitoring, storage, backup, and migration
* Modern endpoint management: SCCM/MECM, Intune, Autopilot, JAMF, OS deployment, and application packaging
* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops / VDI
* Vulnerability management and patching tools (Tenable, Qualys, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike)
* M365 collaboration (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive) and Confluence/Atlassian
* IT asset and order management lifecycle
* Automation (RPA, Ansible) and AI concepts for service delivery

****Preferred****

* 3+ years of technical project management experience
* PMP, Prince2, or Agile certification
* Microsoft certifications (e.g., Endpoint Administrator, M365), JAMF, Citrix, or ITIL certification

****What You'll Get****

* Work with people who exhibit commitment to the client, leadership by example, respect for people, courage to innovate, and humbleness to learn
* Comprehensive benefits including 401(k), paid time off, tuition reimbursement, medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Professional development through Stefanini University eLearning and virtual training

**Why We're Different**

* Brazilian and privately owned company
* Agility, flexibility, and innovation are in our DNA
* Flat organizational structure enabling faster communication and decision making

**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Stefanini, we value plurality and equity, regardless of race, sexual orientation, disability, age, ancestry, religion, gender, and nationality.

The Senior Manager, IT Operations is accountable for the strategy, performance, and continuous improvement of enterprise and field technology support. The role leads the Enterprise Service Desk, Field Services, end-user support, workplace technology, and assigned IT service management functions.
  
  
Serving both corporate and midstream operations, this leader builds strong teams, establishes clear accountability, and delivers reliable, secure, and cost-effective services across office, field, and operational environments.
  
  
**JOB DUTIES & KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Enterprise Service Desk & Corporate Support

+ Own the Enterprise Service Desk as the central point for intake, triage, communication, and escalation across corporate and field operations.
+ Own the executive support function, including service standards, coverage, escalation, communications, and coordination for senior leadership and executive meetings.
+ Set service levels, staffing, quality standards, operating procedures, and performance measures for corporate business functions, executives, and 24x7 field operations.
+ Integrate Service Desk, corporate support, executive support, and Field Services workflows to eliminate delays, duplicate effort, and weak handoffs.
+ Improve first-contact resolution, fulfillment speed, self-service, knowledge use, and support for office-based, executive, remote, and operationally critical users.

* Field Operations Leadership & IT/OT Partnership

+ Lead Field Services across pipelines, terminals, plants, field offices, remote facilities, control environments, and the mobile workforce.
+ Set regional coverage, remote-support, and escalation models for operationally critical locations.
+ Align support with operational priorities, safety requirements, site access, work permits, outage windows, and maintenance schedules.
+ Establish clear ownership and handoffs across IT, Field Operations, and OT.
+ Lead technology support for new facilities, expansions, acquisitions, site moves, construction, turnarounds, and OT deployments.
+ Maintain field-support readiness for severe weather, emergency response, and business continuity events.

* Service Operations & Major Incident Leadership

+ Own end-to-end support performance across Service Desk, Field Services, executive support, and workplace technology.
+ Coordinate the support organization’s response to major incidents affecting workforce productivity or field operations, supporting escalation, stakeholder communication, service restoration, and post-incident review.
+ Partner closely with Infrastructure, Server, Network, Cybersecurity, Cloud, and Enterprise Applications teams to coordinate support activities, drive service improvements, and resolve complex operational issues.
+ Use operating metrics to expose trends, aging work, repeat incidents, service risk, and capacity constraints.

* Endpoint, Mobility & Workplace Technology Operations

+ Own endpoint support, provisioning, refresh, mobility, collaboration, conferencing, printing, and workplace technology services across corporate and field environments.
+ Ensure workplace technology and field devices fit business requirements, environmental conditions, mobility, limited connectivity, and operational work patterns.
+ Oversee onboarding, offboarding, deployment, recovery, break/fix, warranty, and secure disposition.
+ Partner with endpoint engineering, cybersecurity, application owners, and business leaders to improve security, reliability, standardization, and supportability.
+ Maintain inventory accuracy and asset tracking across corporate offices, field locations, warehouses, and remote facilities.
+ Establish and enforce cycle-count standards, investigate variances, and drive timely reconciliation and corrective action.

* IT Service Management & Continuous Improvement

+ Manage assigned Incident, Request, Problem, Knowledge, Service Level, and Continual Improvement practices.
+ Apply ITIL foundations and relevant industry practices to improve service consistency, accountability, and outcomes without unnecessary administrative burden.
+ Use operational data, customer feedback, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned to set priorities and measure results.
+ Maintain a service improvement roadmap tied to business priorities, operational risk, and measurable outcomes.
+ Drive automation, self-service, AI-assisted support, remote support, workflow optimization, and knowledge management where they improve service, speed, or cost.

* People Leadership & Decision Making

+ Build and develop high-performing Service Desk and Field Services teams across a distributed operating footprint.
+ Set clear priorities, decision rights, performance expectations, and escalation responsibilities.
+ Strengthen capability through workforce planning, succession, cross-training, field exposure, and knowledge transfer.
+ Make timely decisions that balance safety, operational impact, cybersecurity, user experience, cost, and long-term supportability.
+ Anticipate material risks, challenge assumptions, and present clear recommendations to Technology and Operations leadership.

* Financial Planning, Vendor & Portfolio Support

+ Contribute to operating and capital planning for support operations, end-user technology, tools, lifecycle programs, vendors, and managed services.
+ Develop investment recommendations tied to operational continuity, productivity, risk reduction, scale, service improvement, or cost avoidance.
+ Support vendor selection, contract and renewal reviews, service-performance management, and commercial evaluations.
+ Maintain support technology roadmaps, standards, lifecycle plans, priorities, risks, and performance outcomes.
+ Maintain asset, licensing, audit, security, and records controls across assigned services.

* Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

+ Represent corporate and field support requirements in strategy, standards, projects, and investment decisions.
+ Communicate service health, incidents, risks, priorities, investments, and results to business, field, technical, and executive leaders.
+ Maintain direct engagement with corporate business leaders, operational leaders, and service partners to validate performance and identify emerging needs.

* Other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IT operations, enterprise support, field services, end-user support, or service delivery experience, including 5+ years leading distributed teams.
* Proven leadership of Service Desk, corporate support, and Field Services in a complex, multi-site environment; industrial or energy experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing ownership, dependencies, changes, and incidents across Corporate IT, Field Operations, and OT.
* Ability to set strategy, execute at scale, lead change, and deliver measurable operating results.
* Operational Leadership: Delivers reliable, secure support across corporate and field operations.
* Enterprise and IT/OT Leadership: Establishes clear ownership, decision rights, and accountability across Corporate IT, business functions, Field Operations, and OT.
* Execution: Converts strategy into operating plans, clear measures, and sustained results.
* Business Judgment: Balances business needs, operational risk, cybersecurity, service, cost, and long-term supportability.
* Executive Communication: Frames issues, options, decisions, and results with clarity and credibility.
* Participate in a leadership escalation rotation for major incidents and critical technology events; this role is not the routine first-line on-call resource.
* Travel up to 25% to corporate offices, field locations, terminals, plants, operational facilities, and vendor sites.
* Comply with applicable site access, safety, personal protective equipment, and operational requirements when visiting field facilities.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move technology equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Regular and reliable attendance.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with enterprise ITSM, endpoint and mobile management, remote support, collaboration, asset management, and automation platforms.
* Experience supporting remote locations with limited connectivity, constrained local resources, or 24x7 operations.
* Experience supporting midstream, pipeline, terminal, plant, gathering and processing, or comparable field operations.
* Experience coordinating service providers, field deployment partners, vendor performance, and workforce capacity.
* Working knowledge of ITIL foundations, financial planning, contracts, licensing, audit controls, cybersecurity, and formal change management; relevant certifications are a plus.

As an ambassador for the Tech department, the Tech Business Manager ensures that the house technology strategies and standards are translated into relevant and effective solutions for the Middle East, while bringing local business needs and opportunities back into Europe Tech roadmaps.

Monitor user satisfaction with Tech services provided, identify areas for improvement and recommend appropriate actions.
  
  
Translate local business needs into clear technology requirements and use cases,

Operational Excellence / Run

Title: Lead System Administrator
Location: Dubai, DU, United Arab Emirates | Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

  

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:** Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:** Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:** Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:** Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:** Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:** MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.
  

**About you:**

  

* **Leadership:** 2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:** SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:** Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.
* **Google Workspace, Atlassian Cloud, Kandji:** Administration of Google Workspace (sharing, OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence: permissions, projects, Okta sign-in). Kandji or another MDM for macOS.
* **AI, advanced level:** You have built an LLM-based automation that your colleagues actually used. In the interview, you will show what was built, how you evaluated errors, where you kept a human in the loop and how much time it saves. "I write prompts in ChatGPT" is not what this role needs.
* **Scripting and APIs:** Confident in Python or similar, and able to review other people's code.
* **Access and audit:** You have taken access reviews through to actual revocation and answered auditors' questions.
* **Money:** You have managed SaaS renewals and can name the amount you saved and explain where it came from.
* **Communication:** Fluent English for vendors, documentation and the team.
  

**Can get you a few bonus points**

  

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.
  

**The UMO Standard**

* **Dynamic Work Environment:** Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Rest & Recovery:** 24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
* **Recharge Week:** After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
* **Full Setup:** Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
* **Growth Ecosystem:** A dedicated learning budget and room to grow as the company grows.
* **Impact & Ownership:** Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

Title: Director - CX & Satisfaction (SA1)
Description:
Director CX & Satisfaction Lead the City Operations CX and Satisfaction function, translating Qiddiya-wide CX strategies, customer journeys, standards, and service principles into coordinated operational delivery across city services, assets, events, frontline operations, and customer touchpoints.
  
  
The role oversees CX planning and execution, customer intelligence, satisfaction measurement, feedback management, service quality assurance, and improvement initiatives, ensuring customer insights are converted into clear operational priorities and actions
  
  
As the principal City Operations CX point of contact, the Director aligns stakeholders across QIC and City Operations to embed consistent customer experiences and continuously improve the end-to-end resident and visitor journey.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Establish and lead the City Operations CX and Satisfaction function, integrating CX Improvement, Customer Intelligence, and CX Planning and Execution within a unified operating framework with clear priorities, delivery mechanisms, interfaces, and accountabilities
* Lead, develop, and manage the CX and Satisfaction team, setting clear objectives and accountabilities, building team capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring coordinated delivery across the function in line with the growth, evolving operational requirements, and maturity of City Operations
* Translate Qiddiya-wide CX objectives, strategies, customer journeys, principles, and standards into operational requirements, initiatives, guidelines, surveys, and coordinated delivery plans for City Operations
* Lead the implementation of CX programmes, projects, standards, and service principles across relevant City Operations functions, frontline operations, and customer touchpoints
* Oversee CX training needs and periodic training programmes for frontline operators to support the consistent application of CX guidelines, procedures, and service principles
* Lead the rollout of customer surveys and data-collection tools, and oversee the capture, consolidation, and analysis of feedback from digital channels, frontline touchpoints, complaints, and other sources, in alignment with DMMO, Strategy, and other relevant CX functions
* Oversee the development and monitoring of CX performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms, translating customer insights, satisfaction results, service quality findings, and recurring trends into prioritised improvement initiatives and executive-level recommendations
* Lead operational CX improvement and service quality assurance across City Operations, including site visits, quality reviews, and cross-functional action plans, escalating material gaps and improvement opportunities where required
* Coordinate the cross-functional resolution of City Operations-related customer issues, ensuring timely follow-up, clear accountability, root-cause analysis, and escalation of recurring or systemic themes to the appropriate QIC stakeholders
* Ensure CX requirements are embedded in readiness assessments and operational plans for new city assets, districts, and major events, in coordination with relevant development, asset management, event, and operational stakeholders

**Generic Responsibilities**

* Act as the principal City Operations point of contact for CX, leading stakeholder engagement across QIC and City Operations to align priorities, coordinate interfaces, and drive the consistent implementation of CX standards, initiatives, and improvement actions
* Coordinate with DMMO on event experience requirements, asset-launch customer journeys, service priorities, satisfaction insights, recurring customer issues, and improvement plans, translating agreed requirements into City Operations readiness and delivery actions
* Coordinate with Strategy to implement CX strategies and plans across City Operations touchpoints, embed policies and guidelines into frontline practices, and share live-operations feedback and customer insights to refine CX strategies and solutions
* Provide relevant QIC teams and City Operations functions with operational requirements, dependencies, feasibility input, service gaps, customer pain points, and frontline delivery challenges to support coordinated planning and decision-making
* Provide CX-related operational requirements, readiness input, frontline coordination, and post-implementation performance feedback for asset launches and major events
* Establish a coordinated operational view of CX data and day-to-day performance, supporting a consistent source of information for decision-making, governance, and continuous improvement

**KEY INTERACTIONS:**
**Key External Interactions**

* Destination Management and Marketing Office (DMMO)
* QIC Strategy
* Q-Tech - Guest Center
* Transport CX and other QIC CX functions
* External operators, service providers, survey partners, and CX technology vendors relevant to the approved delivery model

**Key Internal Interactions**

* Chief of City Operations and City Operations leadership
* City Operations verticals and functions, including City Command Unit, Operational Planning and Performance, City Assets O&M, Security Operations, FLS Operations, Medical Operations, Events Planning and Management, and City ICT Operations
* City Operations frontline/on-ground operating teams

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, Tourism, Operations Management, Service Design, Social Sciences or a related discipline

**Professional Certifications**

* Relevant certification in customer experience, service design, or programme management is advantageous

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of customer experience operations, service quality assurance, customer feedback systems, satisfaction measurement, customer journeys, and frontline service delivery
* Demonstrated ability to establish and lead new functions, develop operating models and governance frameworks, and drive cross-functional accountability in complex environments, including through influence where direct reporting authority is limited
* Ability to translate enterprise CX direction, standards, and customer journeys into practical operational requirements, training, controls, and improvement initiatives
* Strong capability in customer intelligence, survey design, insight generation, trend analysis, performance reporting, and evidence-based prioritisation
* Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder alignment, issue resolution, escalation, and executive communication skills
* Ability to lead the implementation of CX improvements across complex city services, asset launches, major events, and high-volume customer environments
* Strategic leadership, decision-making, team development, delivery orientation, collaboration, and customer centricity

**Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in customer experience, guest experience, service quality, customer intelligence, or a related field, including demonstrated experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams

**Nature Of Experience**

* Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing multidisciplinary CX and satisfaction teams, including setting priorities, building team capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring coordinated delivery
* Senior-level experience in customer experience, guest experience, service quality, customer intelligence, or a comparable operational leadership field
* Experience leading customer-facing operational improvement and cross-functional CX implementation in a destination, hospitality, large-scale entertainment, tourism, mixed-use city, or similarly complex operating environment
* Experience using customer feedback, satisfaction measures, operational performance data, and frontline insights to define, prioritise, and deliver service improvement initiatives
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders and coordinating delivery across strategy, destination management, technology, asset, event, and operational functions

Title: Senior Technology Manager, Loan Servicing Technology
Description:

Title: Director of Information Technology
Description:
**Working at Walker**

At Walker, your contribution matters. Become part of a team you can count on and where your health and safety are our priority. Our team of more than 1200 people work in environmental waste management and recovery, renewable energy, paving and construction, aggregates, and emulsions chemistries. We are a fifth-generation, family-owned company founded in 1887, operating from our base in the Niagara Region with facilities across Canada and the United States. We care about the environment, each other, and our neighbours, and give back to our communities. Join us on our journey to build a sustainable future, together.

**About the Job**

Are you a technology visionary who knows how to turn innovation into business results? We're looking for a strategic IT leader ready to make an impact!

We are seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking Director of Information Technology to lead our organization's technology strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and digital transformation initiatives. Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the organization's technology landscape, ensuring our systems, infrastructure, and digital capabilities support both current business operations and future growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic leader who can balance big-picture thinking with operational excellence. From strengthening our cybersecurity posture and modernizing enterprise systems to championing artificial intelligence and automation, you will help identify opportunities where technology can drive productivity, improve efficiencies, reduce costs, and create competitive advantages. Leading a talented team of 18 IT professionals, you will collaborate closely with executive leadership and business partners across the organization to develop and execute technology solutions that deliver measurable business value.

If you're passionate about innovation, thrive on solving complex challenges, and have the leadership skills to inspire high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you!

**Location:**
Niagara Falls, Ontario

**Salary:**
$160,000–$180,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications

**Reports To:**
Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer

**Team Leadership:**
5 direct reports and 13 indirect reports

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and execute the IT strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational business objectives and corporate strategic priorities.
* Partner with executive leadership and business unit managers to translate business needs into technology priorities, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and business performance.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and IT automation, to drive innovation, strengthen security, and enhance business operations.
* Oversee the architecture, implementation, and ongoing support of network, server, cloud, and communications infrastructure, ensuring reliability, availability, scalability, and security.
* Manage the organization's enterprise systems portfolio and IT service delivery, ensuring systems effectively support business processes, remain current, and provide reliable end-user support with measurable service standards.
* Advance the organization's AI strategy, including AI governance, responsible-use policies, and the implementation of AI tools and solutions that drive productivity improvements, procurement savings, sales growth, and pricing optimization.
* Establish and maintain data governance practices that ensure data quality, privacy, security, and accessibility to support reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives.

* Lead, mentor, and develop the IT team while overseeing IT budgets, capital and operational expenditures, technology projects, system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and vendor relationships.
* Provide quarterly updates to the Board Audit Committee on the progress and status of IT and cybersecurity initiatives, ensuring transparency, accountability, and alignment with organizational priorities.

**Here’s What You Need**

* A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with professional certifications such as CISSP, PMP, or ITIL considered an asset.
* Greater than 15 years experience in IT management, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.

* Extensive knowledge of IT infrastructure, enterprise systems, applications, cloud technologies, and technology architecture.
* Strong expertise in cybersecurity, network security, IT risk management, and compliance, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, site-to-site connectivity, and remote access.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining disaster recovery, business continuity, and cybersecurity strategies to protect organizational assets and ensure operational resilience.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute IT strategies, lead complex technology projects, and drive digital transformation initiatives, including AI, automation, data analytics, and business intelligence.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand business processes, identify technology opportunities, and translate organizational priorities into practical, cost-effective solutions.
* Proven financial and vendor management experience, including developing IT budgets, overseeing technology investments, negotiating contracts, and managing external service providers.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in recruiting, mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing IT teams, with exceptional communication, collaboration, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**What’s in it for you**

* A comprehensive total rewards package and benefits to support your wellbeing

Title: Strategic Account Manager
Description:
**About Orium**
---------------

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
* Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
* Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
* Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
* Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
* Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
* Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
* Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
* Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
* Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
* Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
* A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
* Experience working with B2B clients
* Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
* Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
* Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
* Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
* Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work\*
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows\*
* A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends\*
* Based in Canada

* AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

**Is this Role a Fit for You?**
-------------------------------

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

* **Are passionate about client relationships.** You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
* **Stay calm and direct in hard conversations.** You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
* **Love reframing the problem.** You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
* **Have an interest in making the business work.** You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
* **Prefer depth over volume.** You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
* **Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work.** You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
* **Are naturally curious about AI.** You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
* Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
* Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.
* Pursue independent projects, explore new ideas and challenge yourself in your field with dedicated "Awesome Time" (self-directed professional development) annually and quarterly training budgets.
* On top of standard medical and dental coverage, we offer benefits like a parental leave top-up plan, an EAP, mental health coverage, virtual healthcare and a minimum vacation policy.
* Our Toronto HQ is a modern, ergonomic space with hotelling standing/sitting desks and an open-concept social atmosphere.

Operations Management, Professional Services, Client Implementations, Managed Services, Portfolio Management, Capacity Planning, Resource Allocation, Delivery Process Optimization

**Compensation:**
$150,000 – $220,000

**About the Role**

The VP of Operations and Delivery will lead operational execution across a portfolio of client implementations and managed-services engagements. This hands-on executive leadership role combines strategic operational management with direct oversight of project performance, capacity planning, resource allocation, delivery processes, team development, and client escalations. The position is responsible for improving operational accountability, delivery predictability, and scalability.

The role supports a Salesforce-native loan management platform covering loan origination, servicing, accounting, borrower management, and workflow automation. Customers include non-bank lenders, private lenders, Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs), and financial institutions. Working directly with company leadership, this position will help shape the operating model and build a scalable delivery function supporting increasingly complex enterprise customer engagements.

**What You'll Do**

* Oversee a portfolio of active client implementations and managed-services engagements, maintaining clear visibility into project milestones, risks, dependencies, commitments, and next steps.
* Lead, manage, and coach project managers and implementation professionals, establishing clear performance expectations, ownership, and delivery accountability.
* Own capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational prioritization across project managers, implementation teams, and shared specialists.
* Establish and manage operational delivery cadences, including portfolio reviews, project-health assessments, resource planning, and escalation management.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and intervene directly in at-risk projects or complex client escalations when necessary.
* Standardize implementation and delivery processes, including project planning, status reporting, action tracking, requirements handoffs, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live activities, and post-launch transitions.
* Partner with Solutions and Enablement teams to ensure client engagements receive appropriate product expertise and solution guidance.
* Collaborate with Sales on project scoping, implementation feasibility, customer handoffs, and anticipated resource requirements.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and technical implementation teams to resolve technical dependencies, release risks, and operational delivery blockers.
* Coordinate delivery activities involving customers, implementation teams, product specialists, and third-party vendors.
* Strengthen scope management and change-order processes to identify timeline and commercial implications early.
* Develop operational documentation, tools, standardized processes, and performance metrics that improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and scalability.
* Improve knowledge transfer across teams to reduce reliance on individual subject-matter experts and eliminate persistent operational bottlenecks.
* Build scalable operating processes that support business growth without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Take meaningful ownership of the delivery function and expand its operational capabilities as the business grows.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Company leadership has clear visibility into engagement health, ownership, risks, and upcoming milestones.
* Capacity constraints, resource requirements, and competing priorities are identified before teams become overloaded.
* Projects follow consistent delivery cadences with clearly defined ownership, deadlines, and accountability.
* At-risk engagements are addressed proactively before developing into major customer escalations.
* Implementation timelines and milestone predictability improve.
* Managed-services engagements are consistently prioritized, staffed, and tracked.
* Cross-functional operational blockers are identified earlier and resolved more efficiently.
* Delivery processes become increasingly repeatable and scalable while maintaining the flexibility required by customers.

**Qualifications**

***Required Experience***

* Experience leading a Professional Services, implementation, or client-delivery function within a complex SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Direct responsibility for managing a portfolio of concurrent customer implementations.
* Experience managing project managers, implementation consultants, or comparable client-delivery professionals.
* Experience managing challenging client situations, resolving delivery escalations, and coaching teams through complex implementation challenges.
* Demonstrated success building practical operational processes that teams consistently adopt and follow.
* Experience operating as both a strategic leader and a hands-on operational manager in an evolving business environment.

***Required Skills***

* Strong capabilities in capacity planning, resource allocation, portfolio management, and operational prioritization.
* Working knowledge of requirements gathering, implementation planning, scope management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live processes, and post-launch support.
* Ability to establish clear operational accountability without assuming personal responsibility for executing every project.
* Technical fluency sufficient to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, QA, and technical implementation teams.
* Ability to balance strategic operational leadership with hands-on involvement in complex delivery challenges.
* Strong communication skills, professional client presence, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience in lending, fintech, financial software, Salesforce, or other highly configurable enterprise software platforms is valuable but not required.

**Benefits**

* 100% employer-paid employee medical and dental insurance premiums.
* 401(k) retirement plan with maximum employer matching contributions and progressive vesting.
* Paid time off that increases with years of service, plus 14 paid holidays annually.
* Paid sick leave.
* Four weeks of paid parental leave after one year of full-time employment.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Employer-paid life insurance.
* Optional vision insurance, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), supplemental life insurance, and accident coverage.
* Professional training and Salesforce certification support.
* Employee referral bonus program.
* Fully remote work environment with a distributed team.

Title: Product Operations Manager II (Voice and Wifi)

* Implement operational improvements for product lines based on analysis of service performance.

Infrastructure & Cloud is moving from a project-based structure to a product-led model built on five agile teams (platform areas) spanning cloud, network, reliability, developer experience, and data. The Release Train Engineer is the connective tissue across those teams: the person who makes cross-team delivery predictable, keeps dependencies and risks visible, and gives leadership a clear line of sight into flow and progress. You will partner closely with the product director, who owns product direction and the roadmap, while you own the cadence, the flow, and how the teams execute together.

**Run the train**

* Facilitate PSI planning and the planning cadence across the five teams, including readiness, cross-team syncs, demos, and retrospectives.
* Establish and hold a consistent delivery rhythm across teams that do not run on the same clock today.

**Manage flow, dependencies, and risk**

* Surface and manage cross-team dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks before they slow delivery.
* Keep work moving across team boundaries, and escalate what needs leadership attention.

* Give leadership a single, reliable view of what is in flight, what is at risk, and what is landing.
* Partner with the product director and product owners on prioritization and sequencing.

**Coach and build the practice**

* Coach product owners, delivery managers, scrum masters, and delivery leaders on ways of working across the teams.
* Raise the agile maturity of a newly formed organization.

**Help define the operating model**

* Help design, stand up, and take ownership of the operating model itself, including the playbook, ADO standard, and PSI cadence developed with external partners: cadences, decision rights, intake, and the standards the teams work to.
* Be at the forefront of a new organization as it forms.

* Define and track delivery metrics, and drive continuous improvement across the train.

* Experience leading delivery, portfolio or program management, agile transformations, release trains, or large cross-functional programs.

Title: Vice President, Core Infrastrucutre
Location: Global Village, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
***Posting Type***
Hybrid
  
  
**Job Overview**
Rel aiR is the high-scale, secure, and defensible platform where legal data lives. It runs on infrastructure that has to be available, economical, and compliant in every region we serve. We hold more than 100 petabytes of customer data today, and we are building for hundreds of petabytes in the next three years, scaling potentially to an exabyte within five. This is sensitive data at scale, and managing it requires a global understanding of data management.
  
  
The load is rising from multiple directions at once. More legal work is being done with the help of AI-driven software. AI is supporting more use cases across Legal Data Intelligence. MCP (Model Context Protocol) and third-party builder programs are automating more workflows. And we are moving all new matters to Rel aiR. Together these have taken the AI results we produce from millions to hundreds of millions, and we are headed to billions.
  
  
We are hiring a Vice President of Core Infrastructure to build the foundation for that growth and to join the leadership team of Engineering at Relativity. You will own SQL platform, compute (Kubernetes), reliability and operations, and incident and problem management, and build a new capacity-forecasting function.
  
  
Your strategy will span multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data. You will stay agile when cloud storage capacity is tight, adapt to data sovereignty and local requirements around the world, and work with Security to keep the fortress secure. You will work with engineering teams to raise utilization and route work to the resources available, and you will make sure we use services that meet our economic targets, and use them well.
  
  
**Job Description And Requirements**
**This is a builder’s job.**
We are 25 years old and, in many ways, still a startup. We are growing fast, and the infrastructure we need for the next five years does not exist yet. You will not inherit a mature platform to operate. You will build the strategy, the talent, and the capacity engine while the platform carries production traffic. Our Cloud Native Transformation is re-platforming Rel aiR so that every matter, including the largest and most complex, runs on a cloud-native foundation, and it depends on what you will lead. We need your help to build it and to execute it.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliability customers can feel. Availability and recovery that match the trust customers place in us, with fewer severe incidents and faster resolution.
* Infrastructure with options. Storage and compute across multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data, with the agility to shift when cloud capacity is constrained.
* Global by design. Data placement and operations that meet data sovereignty and local requirements wherever our customers are.
* A secure fortress. Infrastructure and security decisions made together, with a close and trusted relationship between your organization and Security.
* Efficient use of capacity. Engineering teams use resources more fully, work routes to the capacity that is available, and the services we choose meet our economic targets and are used appropriately.
* Infrastructure that carries the transformation. The data and compute platform keeps pace with the Cloud Native Transformation, and structural change ships in steady increments.
* One owner from detection to fix. Incident response and problem management sit in one organization, and the same root causes stop recurring.
* A strong teammate across Engineering. You help set direction beyond your own domain and are known as a leader inside the company and across the industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the vision. Define what infrastructure for a leading data company looks like, and bring your organization and your peers along.
* Own reliability end to end. Observability, site services, on-call, incident response, and problem management sit with you.
* Build the storage and compute strategy. Multiple data centers, multiple storage options, and the capacity model that shows where each choice breaks as data grows toward an exabyte.
* Manage cost as part of the job. Own the economics of the services we use, and work with Finance on how storage and AI costs affect gross margin.
* Partner with Security. Keep the fortress secure through shared priorities, shared roadmaps, and clear ownership.
* Work with engineering teams. Raise utilization, route work to available resources, and adapt to cloud storage availability and to local requirements.
* Build the organization. Recruit the leaders, set the operating rules, and decide the mix of in-house and contract teams.
* Lead across Engineering. Work daily with the leaders of data pipelines, security, AI products, and the builder platform, and take a seat in decisions that reach beyond your domain.
* Use AI to run production. Apply AI to detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Stay in touch with the details. Operate comfortably at 1,000 feet and at ground level. Go deep on a root-cause analysis or a customer escalation and find the cause. Walk to a whiteboard and sketch the architecture, including where it breaks.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A builder’s record. You have built strategy and talent in a fast-growing company, not only operated a mature platform.
* SaaS operations at scale. A record of running infrastructure and site reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform with demanding availability commitments and petabytes of customer data.
* Global data management. Experience placing and operating sensitive data across multiple regions and data centers, and meeting data sovereignty and local requirements.
* Infrastructure leadership. Led organizations of 100+ engineers across SRE, database platform, and container platform disciplines, including contractor teams.
* Cost and capacity economics. You have managed infrastructure cost against economic targets, and made build-versus-buy decisions on storage or compute at petabyte scale.
* Cloud-native depth. Kubernetes, SQL at scale, and a major public cloud. Hyperscale cloud provider experience is valuable.
* Incident leadership. You have reduced severe incidents and time to resolve in a large organization.
* Technical credibility. You can challenge an architecture, a capacity forecast, and an incident review on the merits.

**Valuable But Not Required**

* Regulated or FedRAMP-authorized environments.
* Experience with eDiscovery or other large document platforms.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company or one preparing for an IPO.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the infrastructure under the largest legal data footprint in the world, and build it for an exabyte.
* Join a 25-year-old company that still moves like a startup, with the mandate to shape the strategy and the team.
* Report to the CTO and sit on the Engineering leadership team, with direct access to the executive team and the board.
* Run a platform where an outage delays litigation, investigations, and regulatory deadlines for customers.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation in a private equity-backed company at an inflection point.

**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**
This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.
  
  
The expected salary range for this role is between following values:
  
  
$240,000 and $360,000
  
  
The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Budget Management, Cloud Native, Cloud-Native Architecture, Cloud-Native Computing, Data Management, Data Science, Engineering Management, Innovation, Leadership, Product Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Software Development, System Designs

**Key competencies**

* Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
* Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
* Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
* Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
* Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
* Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling

**Key Responsibilities**
**Handover Governance & Control:**

* Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems entering live operations
* Establish required handover deliverables, review checkpoints, sign-off criteria, and escalation principles
* Ensure handover governance is applied consistently across different District ICT Systems, vendors, and projects
* Maintain control over readiness status, approval pathways, and acceptance conditions

**Operational Onboarding & Service Activation**

* Oversee onboarding of services into ICC, ServiceNow, and related operational support processes
* Ensure support workflows, service structures, escalation paths, and operational contacts are established before go-live
* Confirm that service records, operational inventories, support dependencies, and relevant tool configurations are complete and usable
* Verify that the receiving operations environment is prepared to support the new or changed service from day one

**Documentation, Knowledge Transfer & Support Readiness**

* Ensure delivery teams provide complete documentation packs, SOPs, operating procedures, support guides, and technical records
* Lead the planning and execution of knowledge transfer to BAU teams, including operational training and competency development
* Confirm that operational teams understand the service, support model, known risks, and recovery procedures ahead of service commencement
* Ensure training gaps and documentation issues are identified early and addressed before handover sign-off
* Ensure Data Inputs into ITAM & CMDB

**Contracts, Risks & Reporting**

* Oversee support contract registration, warranty coverage transition, and support responsibilities for externally supported components
* Ensure contractual support obligations are reflected in the live support model and understood by operational teams
* Confirm third-party support contacts, service windows, and escalation commitments are documented and activated
* Track commercial dependencies that could affect service support after go-live

**Handover Risk & Management Reporting**

* Maintain a consolidated view of handover readiness, open risks, unresolved actions, and acceptance blockers
* Chair handover reviews and provide management with clear recommendations on transition readiness
* Escalate incomplete deliverables, support model gaps, or residual risks that may compromise stable BAU operation
* Drive closure of post-handover stabilization issues where formal follow-up is required

**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Delivery teams and system integrators: Handover deliverables, documentation and open actions
* ICC and BAU operations teams: Onboarding, training and day-one support readiness
* ServiceNow, ITAM and CMDB owners: Service records, asset data and tool configuration
* Vendors, OEMs and third-party support providers: Contracts, warranties and escalation commitments
* Procurement and contracts teams: Support obligations and commercial dependencies
* Senior management: Readiness recommendations, risks and escalations

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable
