Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**
================

* Full-time, field-based role with daily travel across Delaware and Maryland
* Participation in a rotating evening and weekend on-call schedule for end-of-day ticket board checks and urgent tickets

**Workplace Policy**
====================

Danella maintains a workplace that is completely free of drugs and alcohol, and employees are subject to random drug testing.

**What We Offer You**
=====================

* Paid on-the-job technical and professional training
* Defined career path for future growth
* Competitive wages and great benefits, including a 401(k) plan match

Title: Broker Relationship Manager
Description:
The Broker Relationship Manager will be responsible for developing, managing and strengthening relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners to drive the promotion and sales of International Private Medical Insurance (IPMI) products offered by Dubai Insurance Company in association with Orange Care Plus.

The role requires a candidate with prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably within broker management, intermediary distribution or health insurance business development, with a strong understanding of the UAE insurance market.

The primary objective is to expand the broker network, generate business opportunities, drive product awareness and achieve IPMI business targets through effective broker engagement and relationship management.

**2. Primary Responsibilities**

1. **Broker Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, intermediaries and distribution partners across the UAE.
* Identify, onboard and activate new brokers to promote DIC's IPMI products.
* Manage existing broker relationships to ensure consistent business engagement and revenue generation.
* Conduct regular broker visits, meetings and business reviews.

2. **Business Development & Sales**

* Drive the promotion and distribution of IPMI products through the broker network.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to expand market reach.
* Generate qualified leads, follow up on business opportunities and drive conversions.
* Achieve agreed business development, premium and revenue targets.

3. **Product Promotion & Market Development**

* Develop a strong understanding of DIC's IPMI product offerings, benefits, coverage and positioning.
* Conduct product presentations, broker training sessions and awareness meetings.
* Communicate product features, competitive advantages and market opportunities to brokers.
* Gather market intelligence and competitor insights to support product positioning.

4. **Business Coordination & Conversion**

* Coordinate with DIC's underwriting, operations and business teams to facilitate quotations, underwriting queries and policy issuance.
* Ensure timely follow-up on broker enquiries, quotations and pending proposals.
* Support brokers throughout the sales cycle, from initial enquiry to policy conversion.
* Monitor business pipelines and ensure opportunities are followed through to closure.

**3. Secondary Responsibilities**

* Prepare periodic broker performance reports, sales pipelines and business development updates.
* Monitor broker productivity, conversion ratios and business contribution.
* Identify opportunities to improve broker engagement, retention and business volumes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve broker concerns and operational challenges.
* Ensure that all business activities adhere to applicable UAE insurance regulations and company compliance requirements.
* Participate in industry events, networking activities and insurance market engagements.
* Provide feedback to management on market trends, competitor activities and broker requirements.

**4. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Professional insurance qualifications or certifications will be an added advantage.

**5. Experience & Competencies**

**Essential Experience:**

* 4–7 years of experience in the UAE insurance industry.
* Prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably in Broker Relationship Management, Intermediary Sales, Distribution or Business Development.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with insurance brokers and intermediaries.
* Exposure to medical insurance or IPMI products is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of the UAE insurance market and broker distribution channels.

**Key Competencies:**

**Job Description**
**What is the opportunity?**
Join RBC's US CIO Technology Strategy and Architecture team as Director, Enterprise Integration Services for the OneRBC: CNB Integration program—a transformational, multi-year initiative that will reshape how RBC operates post-acquisition. In this strategic role, you'll architect and drive the technology integration of City National Bank into RBC's operating model, designing solutions that enable seamless cross-entity operations while establishing repeatable playbooks for future M&A activities.
  
  
This is a career-defining opportunity where you'll partner with RBC and CNB enterprise leadership to synthesize complex requirements into cohesive technology strategies spanning identity & access management, cloud infrastructure, network architecture, security posture alignment, and modern workplace modernization. You'll own the validation and de-risking of integration decisions through proof-of-concept initiatives, ensuring solutions deliver tangible business outcomes while maintaining enterprise standards and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Beyond CNB, you'll build RBC's M&A integration capability—establishing integration playbooks, standards, and governance models that position RBC to confidently and efficiently integrate future acquisitions. If you're a strategic thinker with deep Microsoft and infrastructure expertise, comfort with constructive challenge, and passion for building organization-scale solutions, this role offers the scope and impact to make a lasting difference at an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What will you do?**
**Strategic Integration Design & Delivery**

* Develop end-to-end integration plans and solutions: Define and evolve technology integration for CNB across identity, cloud, network, security, and workplace domains.
* Synthesize requirements into phased roadmaps: Translate competing business/technical needs into actionable plans, balancing trade-offs (e.g., security vs. usability).
* Drive alignment with RBC standards: Partner with enterprise teams to ensure CNB solutions adhere to RBC frameworks while fostering innovation.

**Stakeholder Leadership & Alignment**

* Act as technical liaison: Bridge CNB leadership, RBC CIO, and enterprise teams to maintain alignment on priorities.
* Communicate complex decisions to executives: Present integration trade-offs and business cases in clear, non-technical terms.
* Facilitate cross-functional consensus: Lead design reviews and build trust to resolve conflicts among infrastructure, security, and operations teams.

**Solution Validation & De-Risking**

* Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives: Validate integration assumptions (e.g., identity federation, network testing) before scaling.
* Define success criteria and baselines: Establish metrics to ensure solution efficacy.
* Align with modern SDLC practices: Collaborate with development teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native patterns.

**M&A Integration Capability Building**

* Codify playbooks and reference architectures: Document CNB integration patterns for reuse in future acquisitions.
* Establish governance models: Create standards for technology discovery, risk mitigation, and deployment across M&A scenarios.
* Build and mentor integration talent: Develop RBC’s M&A capability by identifying and grooming future leaders.

**Operational Readiness & Governance**

* Ensure sustainable operations: Partner with support teams to define runbooks, escalation processes, and continuous improvement.
* Maintain regulatory compliance: Align solutions with financial services regulations and audit standards (e.g., cross-border requirements).
* Monitor and optimize post-deployment: Drive enhancements using user feedback, metrics, and lessons learned.

**What do you need to succeed?**
**Must have:**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* 10–12+ years in technology integration, infrastructure, or security leadership roles.
* 5+ years in architect/senior technical leadership roles, leading complex, multi-disciplinary design efforts.
* Deep Microsoft expertise: Azure, Entra ID/Azure AD, Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams), hybrid identity, and federated access.
* Broad infrastructure & security experience: Network architecture, firewall design, cloud infrastructure, IAM, zero-trust principles, and compliance frameworks.
* Financial services regulatory knowledge: Understanding of Canadian/US banking compliance and operational models.
* SDLC fluency: Modern software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization.
* Strategic communication: Ability to translate technical concepts for C-suite audiences and influence senior leadership.

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with RBC’s technology landscape, architecture frameworks, and governance models.
* Prior involvement in technology integration during mergers/acquisitions.
* Multi-tenant architecture: Experience designing solutions for complex, federated organizational structures.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in large, complex, matrix-structured environments.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation, and one that is reinventing itself as the AI platform for the energy industry.
  
  
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Overview**
Serve as a People Leader in the Global Services (GS) business unit, accountable for the successful delivery of Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) and the broader Pipeline Software Suite for midstream customers. QPTM is Quorum's enterprise-grade pipeline transaction management system, used by pipeline and storage operators to manage nominations, scheduling, capacity rights, imbalances, invoicing and settlement, and regulatory compliance. You will lead the team that implements, upgrades and optimizes it for some of the most recognized names in North American midstream.
  
  
**Why This Role, Why Now: Quorum’s Platform Transformation**
Quorum is in the middle of a major transformation. Our vision is to serve as the operating system for the global energy industry: a unified platform where every domain, from subsurface planning to supply chain execution, is connected through a common data foundation and a governed AI layer. We are investing heavily in bringing AI and analytics into the platform, and expanding through strategic acquisitions such as Streamba, an AI-native supply chain platform, announced in June 2026. As this platform evolution reaches our pipeline solutions, Global Services will be on the front line, helping customers move from systems that simply record transactions to a connected, data-driven platform that helps run their operations. This is a rare chance to shape how that transformation is delivered to our pipeline customers and to build the team and delivery model that makes it repeatable.
  
  
**Who Will Succeed In This Role**
The person who succeeds here will be both tech-savvy and deeply grounded in the oil & gas pipeline industry. You understand how a pipeline business actually runs, from nominations and scheduling to capacity release, imbalance management, contract and rate administration, invoicing, and FERC and NAESB requirements, and you can earn the respect of pipeline operators’ commercial, scheduling, accounting and IT leaders on day one. You are equally comfortable discussing cloud deployment, integration architecture, data quality and how AI and analytics can improve a pipeline workflow. You are a leader who can bridge the two worlds: translating what operators need into how the technology is configured, delivered and adopted.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead successful delivery of QPTM and Pipeline Software Suite implementations, upgrades, cloud migrations and legacy system replacements for natural gas and liquids pipeline and storage customers
* Bring deep pipeline industry knowledge to every engagement, guiding customers on scheduling, capacity, contract, imbalance, invoicing and regulatory (FERC/NAESB) processes and ensuring the solution reflects industry best practice
* Drive repeatability and consistency across pipeline implementations through standard delivery methodologies, accelerators and reusable assets
* Manage and lead a high performing team of 15+ employees, including consultants, project managers and technical resources
* Prepare the team and our customers for Quorum’s platform transformation, building fluency in AI, analytics, data and integration capabilities as they are introduced into the Pipeline Software Suite and the wider Quorum platform
* Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field insight into the roadmap, and help shape how new platform, AI and analytics capabilities are deployed with customers

* Support Sales activities, ensuring messaging for services is clearly defined and accurate
* Ensure a high degree of quality for any Services participation in Sales activities
* Effectively contribute to and communicate Company and Services organizational goals and ensure key performance indicator alignment across the business segment
* Drive effective cross-organizational collaboration including Sales, Support, Customer Success, Product and Engineering
* Contribute to a strong team culture in the professional services organization
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in technology or business
* Deep knowledge of the oil & gas pipeline industry, ideally natural gas transportation and storage, including nominations, scheduling, capacity release, contracts and rates, imbalances, invoicing and settlements, and FERC/NAESB regulatory requirements
* Technology savvy, with a working understanding of cloud/SaaS deployment, system integration, APIs, data and reporting, and a genuine curiosity about how AI and analytics are changing enterprise software
* 8+ years in software implementations, preferably large enterprise solution implementations, ideally with pipeline or midstream transaction management systems
* 5+ years leadership experience managing teams of 10+
* Management of revenue, customer satisfaction and project quality goals
* Ability to utilize MS Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.
* Experience in customer facing roles at the executive level
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to effectively deliver presentations to all levels of the organization
* The ability to understand business goals and recommend approaches to effect continual improvements
* Strong organizational skills and an ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities/projects
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with peers in a team-oriented environment

****Company Overview****
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
  
  
****Department Overview****
Silvus Technologies is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high altitude balloons.
  
  
Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense, to International, Federal, State and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers.
  
  
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?
  
  
Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career.
  
  
**Job Description**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Silvus Technologies, the global leader in advanced MIMO mesh networking solutions for defense, industrial, and public safety applications, is seeking a
**Senior Research and Development (R&D) Program Manager**
who will report to the Vice President of Research and Development (R&D).
  
  
This is a foundational role for Silvus R&D that blends technical know-how with strategic thinking and process-oriented execution. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape and deliver key new technology solutions within Silvus’ growing R&D organization. The Program Manager will partner closely with Senior R&D and Engineering leadership, as well as Silvus management, Business Development, and Product teams to define programmatic goals, both technical and strategic, drive cross-functional project execution, and deliver high-impact products to Silvus customers.
  
  
This role is part of a passionate team redefining radio frequency (RF) sensing, electronic warfare and wireless connectivity in the most demanding environments, from battlefield networks and autonomous systems to public safety and industrial applications. You will work alongside world-class engineers solving real-world challenges, with opportunities to grow, innovate, and lead as our organization scales.
  
  
This position is based at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in the heart of vibrant
**West Los Angeles,**
**CA,**
and is on a hybrid schedule, a minimum of 3 days onsite per week is expected. On-site days are Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
  
  
The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end program execution across the full engineering lifecycle, from concept and design through implementation, integration, validation, and productization.

* Track risks, dependencies, and issues; develop mitigation strategies and communicate impacts and resource demands to R&D leadership and upper management.

* Maintain project documentation and dashboards (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) for clear visibility into goals, progress, and key metrics.
* Prepare executive reports and presentations, communicating program status, milestones, and risk assessments to senior management.
* Hire, manage, and mentor various engineers, junior program managers, and other key personnel as needed to support the growth and success of the Silvus R&D organization.
* Perform other related duties, of which the above are representative.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant program management and/or engineering experience in a technology-driven organization.
* Proven experience managing complex hardware/software wireless communications, networking, or electronic warfare programs in a fast-paced R&D or product development environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and shift priorities.
* Exceptional communication and presentation abilities with a track record of influencing across technical and non-technical teams.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen (due to clients under U.S. government contracts).
* All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Ph.D. in EE, ECE, or a related field with 15+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Demonstrated success with hands-on product development, technical program management, or engineering leadership roles.

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.
* Proven ability to develop business and establish relationships with clients.
* Travel 15-25% depending on project assignment and client needs.

Title: Head of Information Technology
Description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Head of IT to lead our global IT function within MultiBank Group. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. The ideal candidate is technically strong, structured, security-minded and comfortable leading people in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Leadership & Engineering Teams**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Support Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering and Jira teams.
* Oversee systems used by the engineering organisation and ensure Jira supports delivery teams effectively.
* Define the IT roadmap and align it with business and regulatory priorities.

**Infrastructure, Cloud & Network**

* Own the in-house cloud servers and hosting environment, including capacity, availability and cost.
* Oversee network engineering across all global offices, including connectivity, performance and monitoring.
* Manage Azure and Cloudflare services, including DNS, WAF and Zero Trust.
* Manage internal corporate domains.
* Run telephony systems such as 3CX.

**Corporate Systems, SaaS & Microsoft 365**

* Take responsibility for the company's SaaS portfolio, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, renewals and offboarding.
* Administer Microsoft 365, including tenant security, licensing and governance.
* Own SSO and user registration and provisioning processes, working closely with Security and HR.
* Understand and oversee API integrations between internal and third-party systems.

**IT Service Management (ITSM)**

* Own the ITSM framework: incident, request, change and problem management, with clear SLAs and reporting.
* Ensure the support desk delivers consistent service to every office and time zone.

**Projects & Global Offices**

* Manage IT projects end to end, from scoping and business case through delivery and review.
* Be responsible for IT in all global offices.
* Lead the IT setup for new offices opened across the globe, including network, devices, access, telephony and local compliance needs.

**Security, Business Continuity & Audits**

* Apply security best practice across the IT estate, working with the Security team to protect systems, data and endpoints.
* Own Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans, including regular testing.
* Be responsible for global and internal IT audits, including evidence preparation, auditor coordination and closing findings.

**Required Knowledge & Experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.
* Track record of setting up new offices from an IT standpoint.
* Strong hands-on experience with:
* Microsoft 365 administration and Azure
* Cloudflare, DNS and domain management
* Enterprise networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, firewalls)
* Private or in-house cloud and server infrastructure
* Telephony platforms
* ITSM tools and frameworks (ITIL or equivalent) and Jira administration
* SSO, identity management and user registration and provisioning flows
* Good understanding of APIs and system integrations.
* Practical security experience across infrastructure, endpoints, access control and data protection.
* Experience designing and testing Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
* Experience leading internal and external IT audits, for example ISO 27001, SOC 2 or regulator-driven reviews.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI tools and the governance they require.
* Experience writing and enforcing IT policies and procedures.
* Experience with IT budgeting, vendor negotiation and cost control.
* Strong project management skills across the full project lifecycle.

**Desirable Knowledge & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (Master's preferred).
* Certifications such as ITIL, CISSP, CISM, PMP or PRINCE2, Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Experience in brokerage, trading or exchange environments with high-availability requirements.
* Experience introducing and governing AI tools across an enterprise.
* Exposure to multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements affecting IT and data.
* Fluency in Arabic or another language relevant to our regions.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.*

Title: Engineering Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead team of software engineers within the Engineering & E-commerce function. Own the delivery, quality and production reliability of the systems within the assigned domain, such as ordering, menu serving, payments, loyalty, aggregator integration, in-store technology or customer platforms. Turn approved priorities into working, reliable software, delivered on time and at a controlled cost. This enables the company to serve customers and locations across markets and grow digital sales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the assigned domain end to end - Own the architecture, roadmap execution, quality and production reliability of the domain’s systems and APIs. The scope of the domain will be assigned in writing by the line manager.
* Deliver the approved roadmap predictably - Define scope, estimate, sequence, manage risks and dependencies, and report status and trade-offs early, in line with the department’s software development lifecycle, so that commitments to the business are met.
* Own the system design and architecture of the domain - Propose designs and architecture changes and make technical trade-offs related to performance, resilience, data consistency, security, cost and time to market. Decisions must remain within the architecture principles and engineering standards established by the Director of Engineering & E-commerce and the engineering leadership.
* Own the reliability of the domain systems - Define and meet service-level objectives. Run on-call support, incident response and root-cause analysis. Monitor systems using the reliability tools provided by Platform Engineering and keep systems fast and efficient under peak loads.
* Use AI by default and advocate its use - Use AI for software development and the automation of other tasks, in line with the department’s AI usage standards. Maintain engineering quality through automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, secure coding and controlled releases, including feature flags, progressive rollouts and rollback plans.
* Act as custodian of the domain’s spend - Track cloud consumption, licences and contractor time. Identify and remove waste and raise cost risks early with the line manager. Commercial and budget decisions remain with the line manager and must follow company processes.
* Build, lead and grow a team of software engineers - Coach team members, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career development. Contribute to hiring through the company’s recruitment process. Direct the day-to-day work of external developers, contractors or vendors when assigned to the domain.
* Align with peers and stakeholders before acting - Agree on interfaces, dependencies and priorities with other Engineering Managers, Product, Operations and business teams. Escalate disagreements to the line manager with clear options. Do not make unilateral decisions that change another team’s work, cost or risk.

**Leadership Requirements:**

* Ownership: Takes full accountability for the domain, its production systems and its people.
* Hands-on credibility: Designs systems and understands the code sufficiently to make sound technical decisions and coach engineers.
* AI-first mindset: Uses AI by default and leads the team to do the same.
* Delivery discipline: Plans realistically, commits carefully and keeps commitments.
* Calm under pressure: Leads clearly during incidents and peak periods.
* Decides through alignment: Works across team boundaries through agreement rather than authority.
* Financial responsibility: Treats company money responsibly in every technical decision.
* People development: Develops software engineers and builds a culture of engineering excellence.

**Major Challenges**

* Deliver new features while maintaining production stability.
* Manage dependencies on other teams and vendors that the role does not directly control.
* Reduce technical debt and modernize legacy systems while keeping the systems operational.
* Maintain delivery quality across a team comprising employees and external developers working in different locations.
* Migrate existing systems to the department’s standard programming language, Golang, while continuing ongoing delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Cloud or architecture certification is an advantage

**Experience:**

* Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least two years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade, high-availability systems
* Experience with consumer digital platforms within quick-service restaurants, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces or logistics is preferred
* Experience working with external developers, contractor teams or vendor teams is an advantage

**Job-Specific Skills:**

* System design and architecture: Service architecture, API design, data modelling, distributed systems, modern system design and cloud principles
* Programming: Golang is preferred. Java, C#, Node.js or PHP are accepted. Willingness to learn Golang and migrate systems to Golang is required
* Databases and caches: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis or Aerospike
* Messaging and streaming: Kafka and RabbitMQ
* Monitoring and reliability: Logs, metrics, traces, service-level objectives, alerting and incident response
* Performance: Profiling, load testing, latency optimisation and cost optimisation
* AI for engineering: Daily use of AI tools for development and the automation of other tasks
* Engineering quality: Automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration and deployment, and secure coding.

**Generic Skills:**

* Clear communication and the ability to translate engineering details into business impact
* Stakeholder management
* Project management, including planning, estimation, risk management and dependency management
* Coaching and performance management

**Competencies:**

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability
* Delivery focus
* Collaboration and influence
* Developing people
* Customer focus
* Integrity

**Technical Competencies**

* System Design and Architecture: Advanced
* Backend Engineering: Advanced
* Reliability, Monitoring and Performance: Advanced
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Advanced
* Data Stores and Messaging: Advanced
* Cloud Principles: Intermediate
* Security and Data Privacy: Intermediate

Title: Sr. Manager/ Business Analyst
Description:
**Role Summary**
: "Defines how the Commercial Brain's decisions are augmented by AI and delivered to customers. This role specifies GenAI personalization, agentic use cases that need more than one step, and the integration of the Brain with every channel: app, web, WhatsApp, SMS, push, chatbot, call center, IVR, retail and partners. The goal is one decision and one context on every channel, with every response flowing back to the Brain. Turns marketing consumer use cases into data and decisioning requirements. "

* Solid understanding of APIs and event-driven integration (REST, webhooks, message queues) and how channels consume a central decision service.
* Agile delivery experience.
* Experience in presenting to and influencing senior executives.
* Onsite in the UAE; fluent English.

"
**Formal Education Required:**
Bachelor of Computer Science Or Bachelor of Engineering Related Professional Training, Certification or Membership: Mandatory:
  
  

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst on mobile services or omnichannel products. Preferred:
* Experience in the telecom industry with knowledge of telecom operations and technologies.
* Experience in organizational change management
* A cloud or AI certification, such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer (AI-102), AWS Machine Learning, or Google Cloud Generative AI Leader: preferred."

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

**What you will bring:**

* **5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance** organisation
* Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like **Platform-as-a-Service** **(OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes**, **cloud management**, and **IT automation** (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
* Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Good verbal and written communication skills in French

**The following are considered a plus:**

* Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
* Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
* **Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**
* Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
* Experience with training and presentation delivery

**About Red Hat**

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat**  
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Title: Senior Manager - Commerce
Description:
**Company Description**
We are a consumer-focused group of commerce experts comprised globally of 1,400+ diverse, passionate and exceptional people. Publicis Commerce partners with the world’s leading marketers and new establishment brands, including Procter & Gamble, Mondelez, Beiersdorf Global, Haleon, Almarai and many more. Publicis Commerce is part of Publicis Media, the global media solutions group which also encompasses Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, Digitas and Performics. Publicis Commerce is focused on the fastest-growing digital advertising landscapes. Our focus covers retail media planning and strategy, retail content development and e-merchandising, and retail media analytics across the digital shelf.
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for a
**Senior Manager, Retail Media**
to lead a Publicis Commerce client pod across the MENA region. You will own the retail media strategy, activation and performance for key brands across marketplaes, omni channel retailers and quick commerce apps such as Amazon, Noon, Talabat, Hungerstation, Nahdi, Ninja etc. There will be a distinct focus on connecting media with digital shelf insights, scaling activation through automation, and guiding and mentoring the team to plan, implement, track, optimise and analyse cross-platform commerce strategies that deliver consistent, measurable growth.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Commerce, you will act as the senior day-to-day lead for clients, collaborate with Publicis Media agencies and the wider commerce activation, content and data teams, and help evolve our regional retail media offer.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Technical & Product \***

* Lead end-to-end retail media strategy, planning and activation across all major retailers, both self-serve and managed.
* Plan and oversee campaigns, using onsite and offsite inventory and audiences (in-market, lifestyle, remarketing, lookalike) for full-funnel reach.
* Define the role of each platform in the plan, from planned baskets on Amazon and noon core to impulse and top-up missions on quick-commerce platforms (noon Minutes, talabat, InstaShop).
* Plan yearly, quarterly and event-based retail media activations aligned to key regional moments (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday, Yellow Friday, back-to-school) and client trade calendars.
* Partner with content and e-merchandising teams to optimise product detail pages so that media drives traffic to pages that convert.
* Apply a strict QA approach across campaign set-up and tracking to ensure our execution is best in class.

**Business Acumen & Operational Efficiency \***

* Deep knowledge of the MENA retail media and quick-commerce landscape, including platform formats, ad tools, partner programmes and market dynamics in GCC.
* Own client retail media budgets and performance targets (ROAS, ACoS/TACoS, share of voice, new-to-brand, incremental sales), prioritising return on investment.
* Act as the senior client lead, delivering clear, high-value updates, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and strategic recommendations.
* Build strong relationships with platform partner teams to secure beta access, premium placements and joint business plans for clients.
* Identify growth opportunities across new platforms, formats and markets to grow client investment, and support new business pitches.
* Oversee execution, activation and optimisation roadmaps with planning and activation support teams.
* Monitor seamless deployment of financial processes (budgets, billing, platform invoicing and reconciliation) via the core admin and ops team.

**Innovative & Analytical Mindset \***

* Analytical mindset and ability to isolate the core drivers of campaign and shelf performance across platforms.
* Strong understanding of attribution, incrementality testing and closed-loop measurement, including Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) and platform reporting.
* Advanced data and audience strategy understanding to maximise targeting relevance, cross-sell and upsell opportunities across key brands.
* Build automated, cross-platform reporting and dashboards (e.g. Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau) that bring media, shelf and sales data into one view.
* Drive innovation by testing new formats, AI and automation solutions, and turning learnings into repeatable playbooks for the team.

**People & Leadership \***

* Take initiative to challenge established points of view with respect and openness.
* Use storytelling to connect with internal and external stakeholders in a compelling manner to influence and inspire.
* Handle complex issues and make decisions even when information is incomplete.
* Proactively develop meaningful relationships with key decision-makers.
* Accept responsibility for client problems, manage conflict, and actively work to resolve issues internally and externally.
* Build succession plans and develop and mentor future talent.
* Provide constructive feedback to others in a timely manner.
* Demonstrate a collaborative and positive spirit and promote inclusivity towards all people.R

**Qualifications**

* BS/MS degree in marketing, business or a related field.
* Proven working experience of 7–9 years in performance media planning / digital marketing, with at least 4 years hands-on in retail media.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon, Noon, Talabat, Hungerstation etc.
* Experience with retail media automation / bid management tools and digital shelf analytics platforms.
* Experience leading a team and managing senior client relationships, ideally in an agency environment.
* Amazon Ads certifications (Sponsored Ads, DSP, AMC) and SQL knowledge are a plus.
* Fluent English; Arabic is a plus.

Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National
Description:
**Business Development Manager - Saudi National**  
**Impact a better future**

At **Serco**, we bring together the right people, technology, and partners to deliver innovative solutions that impact a better future.

We have been operating in the Middle East since 1947 and have a profound understanding of the region.

With over 4,500 colleagues here, we support governments across defence, space, transport, emergency services, justice and migration, and other vital public services. Our core capabilities span service design and advisory, customer experience, complex programme management, systems integration, and asset and facilities management, alongside environmental and case management services.

Guided by our unique service model, we work together with clients and partners to achieve long-term visions and tackle some of the world’s most complex challenges.

**Your Opportunity**

The **Business Development Manager** is responsible for delivering new business revenue and converting opportunities in these sectors across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working under the direction of the Chief Growth Officer, the role drives pipeline development, builds and maintains client relationships and leads the sales effort on assigned opportunities and accounts, supporting Serco's positioning as a trusted, high-quality partner in delivering Vision 2030 priorities.

The role works side by side with the Business Development and Advisory teams, combining personal origination and account management with close collaboration on propositions, bids and the client engagement programme. It targets ministries, government entities, PIF-backed organisations, giga-projects and national energy, defence and space players, converting opportunities into sustainable revenue and operational growth.

* Use market analysis and intelligence, shared with the Business Development and Advisory teams, to identify target clients, emerging trends, competitor activity and whitespace aligned to Vision 2030 priorities.

* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.
* Share client feedback and market insight to strengthen Serco's existing unique selling propositions and inform new products and service offerings.

**Bid Support**

* Work closely with the Bidding team to ensure timely, high-quality submissions for all targeted opportunities.
* Lead the sales input to bids on assigned opportunities, ensuring a persuasive, commercially competitive offering that fully reflects customer requirements.
* Guide assigned bids through Serco's internal governance and approval process, with the support of the Bidding team and the Sales Director.
* Understand local laws, public procurement processes and government buying environments in the KSA.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Representation**

* Advocate for Serco externally and internally at a senior level, representing the Sales Director where required.
* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations and cultural considerations in KSA, and contribute to Serco-wide corporate governance and good practice.

**Specific Requirements**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.
* Demonstrable experience working with government entities, ministries, giga-projects, sovereign-backed organisations and/or PIF-related environments.
* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.
* Exposure to the defence and space sectors, including engagement with defence and space entities, programmes and partners.
* Proven track record of originating and closing complex opportunities and delivering significant annual revenue in government services, consulting or related sectors.
* Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, including strategic partnerships, JVs and multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.
* Appreciation of localization, Saudization and in-Kingdom value creation expectations, with high cultural awareness.

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

Description:

Nous ouvrons la voie et générons un impact.
  
  
Nous sommes des visionnaires.
  
  
Nous sommes WSP.
