Prenez les commandes de la stratégie, de la livraison, de la gouvernance et de l’excellence opérationnelle des plateformes technologiques qui soutiennent les applications d’ingénierie de WSP à l’échelle mondiale. Dans ce rôle de leadership, vous contribuerez à créer des environnements sécuritaires, évolutifs, résilients et rentables couvrant notamment l’hébergement d’applications, les plateformes infonuagiques et hébergées par des fournisseurs, l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel (VDI), la gouvernance des données, l’automatisation et les technologies d’ingénierie de nouvelle génération.
  
  
En collaborant avec les équipes Client Delivery Solutions (CDS), Infrastructure, Sécurité, Architecture, Données et IA ainsi qu’avec les équipes d’ingénierie, vous contribuerez à créer les conditions permettant à nos équipes de projets et à nos professionnels de l’ingénierie de donner le meilleur d’eux-mêmes, tout en préparant WSP aux technologies et aux méthodes de travail de demain.
  
  
**Votre impact**

* Façonner la stratégie et les opérations des plateformes d’ingénierie : Définir et gouverner la stratégie technologique des plateformes soutenant les applications d’ingénierie mondiales. Assurer la préparation opérationnelle, la disponibilité, la performance, la résilience et l’évolutivité des environnements technologiques d’ingénierie. Établir les normes de plateforme, les cadres de gouvernance technique et les procédures d’exploitation des services, tout en dirigeant la planification du cycle de vie et les initiatives de modernisation.
* Faire évoluer l’infrastructure de bureau virtuel et les environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route relatives aux environnements VDI et aux solutions informatiques à distance pour l’ingénierie. Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure afin d’optimiser la performance, l’expérience utilisateur, l’accélération graphique et les charges de travail d’ingénierie. Définir les normes relatives aux postes de travail d’ingénierie, aux postes infonuagiques et aux modèles de prestation hybrides, tout en évaluant les technologies et les nouvelles approches de déploiement.
* Gouverner la demande, la livraison et les ressources : Superviser l’admission, la priorisation et la réalisation des initiatives technologiques d’ingénierie. Gérer l’affectation des ressources, la planification de la capacité des équipes et les priorités de livraison. Collaborer avec le CDS Front Door, le PMO, l’Architecture et les parties prenantes d’affaires afin d’assurer la bonne exécution des initiatives de plateforme, tout en surveillant la performance de livraison, les risques, les dépendances et la réalisation de la valeur.
* Renforcer la gouvernance des données et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’information : Définir les pratiques de gouvernance et de gestion du cycle de vie des données provenant des applications d’ingénierie. Élaborer des stratégies de conservation, d’archivage, de récupération, de conformité et d’accessibilité à long terme. Gouverner les environnements applicatifs hébergés par des fournisseurs ainsi que ceux hébergés dans l’environnement infonuagique de WSP. Collaborer avec les équipes Gouvernance des données, Sécurité, Juridique et Conformité afin de respecter les normes de l’entreprise et soutenir les stratégies favorisant l’analytique, l’IA et la livraison numérique.
* Accélérer l’innovation et l’adoption de technologies d’avenir : Évaluer les technologies émergentes, les services infonuagiques, les plateformes d’ingénierie alimentées par l’IA et les possibilités d’automatisation. Élaborer des feuilles de route technologiques adaptées à l’évolution des modèles de prestation en ingénierie. Cerner les possibilités d’amélioration de la productivité, de l’évolutivité, de la durabilité et de l’expérience utilisateur, et diriger des preuves de concept, projets pilotes d’innovation et programmes de modernisation technologique.
* Diriger la gouvernance des plateformes et la collaboration interfonctionnelle : Collaborer avec les équipes Infrastructure, Cybersécurité, Architecture d’entreprise et Opérations afin d’assurer l’alignement des plateformes. Définir les normes techniques, les pratiques de gestion du changement et les processus de gouvernance opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que les changements apportés aux plateformes d’ingénierie soient testés, documentés et soutenus sur le plan opérationnel, tout en assurant un leadership lors d’escalades techniques complexes et d’initiatives de plateforme à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
* Assurer la gestion financière et le leadership auprès de la haute direction : Gérer les budgets des plateformes, les prévisions, la planification des investissements et les initiatives d’optimisation. Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité et des recommandations d’investissement technologique. Favoriser l’optimisation des coûts liés à l’infonuagique, à l’infrastructure, à l’hébergement et aux services opérationnels, et produire des rapports destinés à la direction, des tableaux de bord, des présentations et des mises à jour de gouvernance.
* Développer l’équipe mondiale et le modèle opérationnel : Diriger et développer une équipe mondiale de spécialistes des plateformes et des technologies d’ingénierie. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des modèles évolutifs de prestation et de soutien. Diriger la planification de la main-d’œuvre, le développement des capacités, le perfectionnement des compétences et la planification de la relève. Établir des structures de gouvernance et des modèles d’engagement pour les parties prenantes d’affaires et les équipes TI interfonctionnelles, tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, d’innovation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.

**Les compétences qui vous distinguent**

* Formation et leadership des plateformes d’entreprise : Baccalauréat en technologies de l’information, informatique, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une expérience significative dans la gestion de plateformes d’entreprise, de services d’infrastructure, de technologies infonuagiques ou d’environnements d’applications d’ingénierie.
* Expertise des environnements informatiques d’ingénierie : Expérience des environnements VDI, de l’informatique d’ingénierie, des plateformes d’hébergement infonuagique et de la prestation d’applications à l’échelle de l’entreprise. Une expérience des écosystèmes d’applications liés à l’ingénierie, au BIM, aux SIG/GIS, à la livraison numérique, à la simulation ou à la conception constitue un atout.
* Expertise en gouvernance des données : Solide compréhension des pratiques de gouvernance, de conservation, d’archivage et de gestion du cycle de vie des données, combinée à une connaissance des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, de cybersécurité et de gouvernance des données.
* Leadership dans la réalisation d’initiatives complexes : Expérience de la gestion de portefeuilles de livraison technique et d’initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes. Expérience avec ITIL, Agile, SAFe ou des méthodologies de livraison comparables.
* Leadership mondial et modèles opérationnels : Expérience de la direction d’équipes techniques mondiales et de la transformation de modèles opérationnels.
* Gestion financière et investissements technologiques : Solide expérience de la gestion financière et des investissements technologiques, notamment en matière de budgets, de prévisions, de dossiers d’affaires, d’investissements et d’optimisation des coûts.
* Transformation infonuagique et modernisation : Expérience avec Microsoft Azure, les architectures cloud natives, les plateformes DaaS/VDI ainsi que les initiatives de modernisation de l’infrastructure. Expérience dans la direction de transformations infonuagiques et d’initiatives de modernisation des plateformes.
* Influence auprès des parties prenantes et de la haute direction : Excellentes aptitudes en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation. Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Pourquoi choisir WSP? Notre raison d’être est de façonner les communautés pour faire progresser l’humanité. Les ingénieurs, conseillers et scientifiques parmi les plus brillants du monde ont choisi WSP.

Description:
Job Description:

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

Title: Panel Builder Program Leader META
Description:
**Job Description**
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
  
  
**About Eaton**
Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.
  
  
The
**Panel Builder Program Manager, META**
is responsible for developing, governing and scaling Eaton’s panel builder partner program across the Middle East, Türkiye and Africa. The role creates a consistent regional framework that enables Eaton to recruit, engage, develop and grow panel builder partners while allowing effective adaptation to local market needs.
  
  
Reporting to Commercial Excellence & Marketing META, the role works through country sales, channel marketing, product and segment teams to strengthen partner capability, increase specification and preference for Eaton solutions, generate sustainable project pipeline and improve Eaton’s share of wallet. The role provides functional leadership to the regional panel builder community and serves as the central marketing and program contact for strategic panel builder partners.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the META panel builder program strategy, framework, value proposition, governance and annual operating plan, aligned with regional commercial priorities and Eaton’s brand standards.
* Define partner segmentation, qualification criteria and tiering based on capability, market potential, strategic fit, performance and commitment to Eaton.
* Design the end-to-end partner lifecycle covering recruitment, onboarding, certification, enablement, activation, development, retention and performance management.
* Build differentiated benefits and requirements for each program tier, including training, technical support, demand generation, digital tools, recognition and joint business planning.
* Lead functional alignment of country sales and marketing teams responsible for local program deployment; provide playbooks, tools, training and performance guidance.
* Develop joint business and marketing plans with priority panel builders, including agreed growth objectives, target segments, opportunity pipelines, campaigns and investment plans.
* Coordinate technical and commercial enablement with Product, Segment, Sales and Engineering teams, including solution training, design support, application guidance and new-product introductions.
* Create scalable to-partner and through-partner communications, localized content, co-branded campaigns and events that increase engagement and generate demand.
* Drive adoption of partner portals, product configurators, digital design tools, partner locators, customer relationship management and other relevant digital platforms.
* Establish clear program measures and dashboards covering partner recruitment, certification, engagement, pipeline, conversion, revenue, share of wallet, digital adoption and satisfaction.
* Govern program investments and marketing development funds, ensuring transparent allocation, compliant execution and measurable return on investment.
* Capture partner and customer feedback through structured voice-of-customer activities, advisory forums and satisfaction surveys; translate insights into program improvements.
* Coordinate relationships with strategic regional panel builders and relevant industry associations while supporting country teams in developing local partner communities.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, engineering or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in B2B channel, partner-program, commercial or marketing roles within the electrical industry. Demonstrated experience working across multiple META markets and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority is required.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of panel building, low-voltage electrical distribution, partner-program design and channel business models.
* Proficiency in partner segmentation, joint business planning, demand generation, pipeline management, marketing investment governance, performance analytics and digital partner platforms.
* Working knowledge of applicable data-privacy, competition and compliance requirements.
* Advanced stakeholder management, communication, presentation, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Strong strategic and analytical thinking, customer focus, cultural awareness, project management, accountability and decision-making.
* Able to lead through influence, manage competing priorities and convert partner insight into scalable regional actions.

**Living and Working in Dubai**
Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
  
  
At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

Own the operational blueprint for scaling markets through distinct growth phases — from launch (0–5K orders/day) through rapid growth (5K–20K) to mature operations (20K+). This is a hands-on role: redesigning shift structures as volume doubles, deciding when to transition fleet models, building playbooks that turn a 10-person team into a 50-person team without losing service quality. Also serves as the primary Operations liaison to Product and Tech, ensuring the platform evolves to support each scaling phase.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**

* Own the end-to-end operational scaling playbook for each growth phase: launch (0–5K orders/day), growth (5K–20K), and maturity (20K+) — defining what changes at each transition in team structure, processes, tooling, fleet model, and vendor operations.

* Conduct operational stress tests: simulate peak scenarios, holiday surges, and failure modes to identify scaling weaknesses before they hit production.
* Act as primary Operations liaison for Product and Tech — translate real scaling pain points into product requirements and feature requests.
* Participate in product roadmap planning, advocating for features that enable scaling: auto-dispatch improvements, dynamic zone management, automated vendor onboarding, real-time capacity dashboards.
* Monitor operational impact of product releases.

At Inverto in Riyadh, we’re defining what’s next in procurement and supply chain—driven by ambition, precision, and impact. With the strength of BCG behind us and a sharp entrepreneurial mindset at our core, we partner with leading global organizations to deliver strategies that create lasting value.
  
  
Our people are central to that mission. As experts who move with intent and momentum, we continually invest in developing our capabilities, expanding our reach, and scaling our impact. Growth at Inverto is shared growth-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The Business & Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
  
  
Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go-to-market execution, and supports high-quality decision-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
  
  
The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
  
  
A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
  
  
Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Management and GTM support
* Partner with Inverto Managing Directors, Principals, and Inverto EMESA to operationalize the Inverto growth plan and operating model by translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and effective execution
* Liaise with the Inverto Business Excellence team and local Inverto leadership to ensure full transparency in the BD pipeline, including tool management / data accuracy, process alignment, and effective governance of local Inverto leads
* Enable commercial success by creating visibility into local platforms (e.g., local BCG lead calls), synthesizing insights, and supporting senior stakeholders with actionable steering information
* People & Talent Management
* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs
* Shape the Middle East hiring strategy jointly with Inverto EMESA and local recruiting teams, contributing to the attraction and retention of top consulting talent and enhancing the effectiveness of selection processes
* Coordinate and improve professional development initiatives - including career development, training, retention, and team affiliation - liaising with EMESA team
* Lead local people-related initiatives that strengthen team cohesion and organizational culture
* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams
* Support driving the Teaming process in partnership with Inverto’s central Teaming Team, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Financial Planning & Performance Management
* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration & Data flow
* Maintain strong and effective collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA teams (BST, HR, IT, etc.), enhancing cross-functional processes and ensuring smooth operational integration
* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management & Compliance Coordination
* Support governance, risk management, and compliance efforts by ensuring alignment of local operations with Inverto EMESA and BCG Core requirements, while proactively identifying improvement areas
* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up-to-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination & Office Enablement
* Oversee day-to-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence

What You'll Bring
  
  
Bachelors or Masters degree with an above-average grade.
  
  
8+ years of relevant experience within business operations
  
  
Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
  
  
Who You'll Work With
  
  
Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
  
  
Working with global, regional and local teams
  
  
Hyper motivated individuals
  
  
Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
  
  
Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win

Title: Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 177059

  

About Al-Futtaim

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

**Overview Of The Role:**
  
The Retail Operations Manager is tasked with ensuring operational excellence across the store network by adhering to company standards and maximising commercial performance. This role is crucial for delivering a top-tier customer experience and involves leading store teams to accomplish objectives related to sales, profitability, compliance, and personnel development. It encompasses driving business growth and supporting various business initiatives.

**What You Will Do:**

#### **Commercial Performance**

* Drive sales, profitability, and productivity across all stores.
* Monitor and improve key retail KPIs including Sales, Conversion, ATV, IPC, UPT, Footfall, NPS, Shrinkage, and EBIT.
* Identify trading opportunities and implement actions to maximize revenue and margin.
* Lead business reviews and recovery plans for underperforming stores.
  

#### **Store Operations**

* Ensure consistent execution of operational standards, policies, and procedures.
* Monitor store compliance, audit results, health & safety requirements, and company governance standards.
* Oversee stock management, inventory accuracy, replenishment, and shrinkage control.
* Ensure efficient rota planning and labor productivity management.
  

#### **Customer Experience**

* Champion customer service excellence across all locations.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
* Ensure stores consistently deliver brand standards and customer experience expectations.
  

#### **People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and field leadership teams.
* Drive succession planning and talent development.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and capability-building initiatives.
* Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability and engagement.
  

#### **Projects & Change Management**

* Support new store openings, relocations, pop-ups, and refurbishment projects.
* Lead operational readiness activities for business initiatives.
* Work cross-functionally with Commercial, HR, Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Property teams.
  

#### **Financial Management**

* Manage operational budgets and cost controls.
* Deliver profit improvement initiatives.
* Monitor payroll, overtime, consumables, and operational expenditure.
  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Commercial Acumen
* Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving
* Leadership and Coaching
* Stakeholder Management and Communication
  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* 5-10+ years of retail management experience.
* Multi-site retail leadership experience is preferred.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with P&L ownership.
* Proven experience in leading large teams across multiple locations.
  

About Al-Futtaim Retail

  

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.

  

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.
  
  
Compensation Range: CA$95K - CA$120K

Title: Team Lead, Digital Services Support (East)
Description:
The Team Lead, Digital Services Support - Eastern Canada is responsible for providing day-to-day leadership, coordination, and operational oversight for the Eastern Canada Digital Services Support team. This role combines technical expertise with people leadership to ensure the delivery of responsive, customer-focused IT support services across district offices, project sites, and executive locations throughout Eastern Canada.
  
  
The Team Lead acts as the primary escalation point for the regional support team and is responsible for workload management, staff development, performance coaching, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. The position works closely with Digital Services leadership, Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Enterprise Applications, Procurement, and ServiceNow teams to ensure a consistent and high-quality support experience.
  
  
This role maintains a hands-on technical presence while providing leadership and guidance to Digital Support Technicians and Digital Site Support Technicians.
  
  
**What You Will Be Working On**

* Provide day-to-day leadership, guidance, and oversight to the Eastern Canada Digital Services Support team.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical, operational, and customer service issues.
* Coordinate team workload, priorities, staffing schedules, and regional support coverage.
* Monitor service delivery performance, ticket queues, backlogs, and service level compliance.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through regular feedback and performance management.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and career development of support staff.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with district leadership, project teams, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure effective support for district offices, project sites, and executive/VIP users throughout Eastern Canada.
* Lead planning and coordination of office openings, project mobilizations, relocations, and site deployments.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer experience, operational efficiency, and automation.
* Promote adoption of ServiceNow processes, knowledge management, and self-service capabilities.
* Oversee regional IT asset management activities, including inventory accuracy, evergreen replacements, and asset recovery.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Enterprise Applications, Procurement, and ServiceNow teams to resolve issues and deliver projects.
* Ensure compliance with corporate IT standards, security requirements, and governance processes.
* Prepare and report on operational metrics, service trends, risks, resource requirements, and improvement opportunities to management.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT support and service delivery.
* 5+ years of leadership, supervisory, mentoring, or team coordination experience.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Intune, and endpoint management technologies.
* Experience supporting ServiceNow ITSM, ticket management, and service delivery processes.
* Knowledge of IT asset management, CMDB concepts, hardware lifecycle management, and inventory controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, manage priorities, and coordinate regional support operations.
* Excellent customer service, stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities in complex environments.
* Ability to travel throughout Eastern Canada to support offices, project sites, and business operations as required.

Title: Director, IT Service Desk
Description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

**About the position:**

Netskope is on a mission to redefine cloud, data, and network security, and the IT Infrastructure & Operations team is the backbone of that mission. We are seeking a hands-on, servant-leader to elevate and transform our global Service Desk organization into a strategic asset. This is not a typical “ticket-closing” role; it is a critical leadership position focused on redefining IT support as a product, driving automation, expanding self-service, and harnessing Generative AI to deliver a frictionless, consumer-grade employee experience. The Director of IT Service Desk will partner with IT product leadership to build and mature the service catalog with defined and measurable SLAs, own IT change management, and implement a data-driven strategy that improves support quality, reduces friction, and enables Netskope employees worldwide to innovate and move faster.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead & Inspire a Global Team: Provide strategic direction and leadership for a distributed organization of L1 and L2 support engineers. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and exceptional service while defining clear career paths and growth opportunities. Ensure balanced, 24x7 global coverage aligned to business needs.
* Run the Service Desk as a Product: Treat the Service Desk as a core IT product with defined ownership, a service roadmap, and measurable outcomes. Align priorities with the IT product operating model, applying product management principles to deliver continuous improvements in employee experience and productivity.
* Drive a Self-Service and Automation Mindset: Champion an automation-first approach that eliminates repetitive work and accelerates service delivery. Build a culture of self-service by leveraging AI-powered virtual agents, intelligent knowledge bases, and automated workflows to scale support.
* Leverage GenAI for Transformation: Lead the adoption of Generative AI to transform IT support, from ticket deflection to intelligent resolution.
* Build and Own the Service Catalog: Partner with IT product leadership to define, maintain, and evolve a comprehensive service catalog with clear, measurable SLAs. Continuously enhance the catalog through automation, AI integration, and employee feedback.
* Own IT Change Management: Take responsibility for IT change management processes, ensuring changes are implemented in a controlled, transparent, and agile manner that balances risk and speed.
* Champion Knowledge & Digital Self-Service: Establish a world-class knowledge management program, transforming Confluence into a central hub for high-quality documentation and self-help resources. Reduce inbound tickets through proactive problem identification and scalable self-service enablement.
* Elevate the Employee Experience: Reimagine IT support as a modern, consumer-grade experience. Enhance Slack as a frictionless support channel, expand the Assist Bot’s capabilities, and deliver seamless IT support to all Netskopers.
* Be Customer Zero: Lead by example in leveraging Netskope’s own products, especially Digital Experience Management (DEM), to proactively diagnose and resolve issues. Provide actionable feedback to product and engineering to strengthen the customer value proposition.
* Measure What Matters: Define KPIs, build executive dashboards, and present insights on service quality and team performance. Use analytics to guide investment decisions, identify systemic issues, and improve outcomes across IT.

**Requirements:**

* Work Location: Must be available on-site 4 days per week at our Santa Clara, CA or St. Louis, MO office.
* Seasoned IT Leader: 12+ years of IT experience with 7+ years leading large-scale, global Service Desk or Helpdesk operations in high-growth SaaS or technology environments.
* Strategic Operator with a Product Mindset: Experienced in working within an IT product operating model. Skilled at defining services as products, building roadmaps, and delivering iterative improvements that enhance employee experience.
* Automation & AI Advocate: Proven record of driving self-service adoption and automation at scale. Hands-on experience with AI-powered ITSM and employee experience platforms such as MoveWorks, Aisera, or similar solutions.
* People Leader & Talent Builder: Mentor who develops leaders, builds high-performing teams, and fosters a customer-first service culture.
* Data-Driven Decision Maker: Expert at using ITSM metrics and analytics to identify trends, guide strategy, and measure outcomes.
* ITSM & Governance Expert: Strong knowledge of ITIL and modern service management practices, with demonstrable experience applying them in a product-based IT model. ITIL certification preferred.
* Business Partner & Communicator: Exceptional ability to engage and influence executives, stakeholders, and employees alike.
* Bonus Skills: Familiarity with Okta, Google Workspace, M365, Kandji, Intune, and SaaS lifecycle management vendors
* Executive Leadership: Proven ability to lead global IT Service Desk organizations and shape digital employee experience strategy.
* Product Mindset: Experience applying product management principles within IT, including roadmap planning, service ownership, and iterative delivery.
* Self-Service & Automation: Strong record of scaling self-service and driving automation, with experience implementing AI-driven platforms such as MoveWorks or Aisera.
* Operational Excellence: Expertise in service delivery, ITIL frameworks, and IT change management.
* Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of multi-OS environments (Windows, Mac, ChromeOS) and network/system troubleshooting.
* Data & Metrics Mastery: Ability to define, track, and communicate KPIs that drive accountability and improvement.
* Change Leadership: Skilled at transforming IT support functions, scaling globally, and building a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant discipline preferred

**Compensation:**

For purposes of complying with applicable laws, the range applies to candidates in California, Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, New York, Washington, and other states.

The successful candidate’s starting pay will also be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, location, and market conditions.

In addition to salary, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus plan (for non-sales roles) and a stock award program. Candidates may also be eligible for a comprehensive health plan and other benefits that can be reviewed at Netskope Benefits site.

Title: Director End User Support Services
Description:
**Position Overview**
The Director, Enterprise End User Support Services is accountable for delivering a consistent, secure, and high-quality technology experience for Burlington associates across corporate offices, stores, distribution centers, field leadership, and executive users. This role owns the end-to-end End User Services operating model, including Executive/VIP support, Service Desk, Desktop and Field Support, endpoint lifecycle management, device readiness, modern workplace technologies, and support experience governance. The Director ensures associates have the technology, support, and service responsiveness required to stay productive and connected while maintaining strong operational discipline, security compliance, and service quality. This leader partners closely with senior business leaders, Store Operations, Supply Chain, Infrastructure, Security, Applications, and vendor partners to improve user experience, reduce business disruption, strengthen endpoint reliability, and drive continuous improvement across the enterprise support ecosystem.
  
  
**A Day In The Life**

* End User Experience, Strategy & Adoption
* Define and execute the enterprise End User Services strategy and roadmap aligned to Burlington’s business priorities, growth, and operational needs.
* Own the End User Experience improvement agenda, using CSAT, feedback, operational metrics, and service trends to identify opportunities and drive measurable improvements.
* Lead adoption and change enablement for modern workplace tools, endpoint services, and support model changes to improve associate productivity and technology adoption.
* Build strong partnerships with corporate, store, distribution center, and field leadership to ensure support services are aligned to business needs.
* Establish structured feedback channels through surveys, leadership input, service reviews, and user forums, and drive closed-loop actions to improve the service experience.
* Service Desk, Desktop & Field Support Operations
* Lead enterprise L1/L2 Service Desk, Desktop Support, and Field Support operations supporting corporate offices, stores, distribution centers, field leadership, and remote users.
* Define and enforce standardized support models, intake channels, escalation paths, service expectations, and operating procedures across all supported locations.
* Ensure reliable support coverage for onsite, remote, hybrid, mobile, and executive users, including business-critical periods, peak events, and high-impact technology rollouts.
* Own staffing, shift coverage, on-call models, escalation rotations, workload balancing, and labor utilization to maintain consistent service levels and operational responsiveness.
* Drive operational excellence across internal teams and external partners through service reviews, performance management, quality controls, and continuous improvement actions.
* Executive & VIP Support Leadership

Title: MNOC West Lead

provides senior operational leadership, technical oversight, and strategic direction for a mission-critical Network/Mission Network Operations Center supporting 24x7 operations. The NOC Lead is responsible for ensuring the

of network and IT services supporting the MSC fleet.

Wahiawa, HI

Full-Time

On-Site

Active Top Secret Clearance Required

High School Diploma or Equivalent

Title: Business Operations Manager
Description:
**Business Operations Manager**

*• Business Development • Dubai, UAE • Justlife*

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.

This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and **measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months**. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.

**You'll love this role if you...**

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

**What you'll own**

* **Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate %** by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures.
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability.
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster.
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises.
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result.
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows.
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same.

**What tells us you're the one**

* You've **measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce** — *tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%*.
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix.
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot.
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think.
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing.

**Why Justlife**

* **Scale and impact:** You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin.
* **Clear growth path:** this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC.
* **Close partnership with leadership:** you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions.
* **A fair, performance-driven culture:** you'll be measured on the metrics you own, recognised through our JustHeroes program, and rewarded for results — not politics.
* **Startup benefits:** a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife service credits, referral bonuses, and regular team experiences.

***Join the tribe and let's become #everydaybetter, together.***

Title: Manager, Business Operations Analyst
Description:
About Beanfield

  

We don’t just build networks, we build communities. From our roots in Liberty Village to our growing footprint across Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver, Beanfield has spent 35+ years connecting people through a robust, independently owned fibre-optic network.

  

With 500+ employees and an entrepreneurial mindset, we move fast, think creatively, and stay connected to the people who make Beanfield what it is. If you thrive in a collaborative, high-impact environment where your work matters, you will feel right at home.

  

Our headquarters is located in Toronto’s super-hip Liberty Village, surrounded by great coffee, food, energy, and creativity—making it a great place to collaborate in person.

  

Our Values

  

We Are Challengers
  
  
  
We lead the way. We disrupt the industry by thinking differently, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We operate with a startup mentality and believe in building and investing in our own infrastructure, and our people.

  

We Are United
  
  
  
We operate as one team. Collaboration is core to how we work, and every idea matters. We believe strong partnerships and shared ownership lead to better outcomes.

  

We Care
  
  
  
We care deeply about our employees, partners, customers, and communities. We build trust through open communication, thoughtful decisions, and a relentless focus on our brand and customer experience.

  

The Role

  

Beanfield is looking for a hands-on Manager, Business Operations Analyst to lead our growing team of Business Operations while actively driving high-impact technical and operational initiatives. Reporting directly to the Director, Business Operations, you will play a pivotal role in scaling how we work.

  

In this "player-coach" role, you will divide your time between mentoring direct reports, standardizing how our BA practice operates, and acting as the lead Business Analyst for major enterprise initiatives—most notably our upcoming ServiceNow implementation and broader system rollouts. You will bridge the gap between cross-functional business units and technical teams to ensure our processes are scalable, documented, and aligned with Beanfield’s growth.

  
  

What’s in it for you

  

  
* A united, values-driven culture that genuinely cares about people, collaboration, and community.
  
* A comprehensive total rewards package, including Traditional Spending Account (TSA) and Health Care Spending Account (HCSA) coverage to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  
* An additional five (5) personal care days, giving you extra flexibility to recharge, reset, or take care of what matters most.
  
* Hybrid work policy - 3 days a week
  

  
  

What You’ll Do

  

Leadership & Practice Standardization

  

  
* Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Business Analysts, conducting regular 1-on-1s, workload balancing, and performance reviews.
  
* Process & Documentation Alignment: Establish, standardize, and enforce consistent BA methodologies, templates, and documentation standards (BRDs, process flows, user stories) across the entire team.
  
* PMO Collaboration: Partner with the Project Management team to establish shared governance, standards, and delivery methodologies across the organization.
  

  

Enterprise System Implementations (ServiceNow & Core Systems)

  

  
* End-to-End Implementation Ownership: Act as the lead BA owning all business analysis lifecycle tasks for Beanfield’s ServiceNow implementation and subsequent enterprise system rollouts—including requirements gathering, process design, functional specifications, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and post-launch support.
  
* Requirements & Design: Document and develop high-calibre business process flows, functional requirements, and system design documents for new business needs.
  
* Stakeholder Facilitation: Facilitate working sessions and discovery discussions among business leaders and cross-functional teams to map out internal operations and define clear requirements.
  

  

Continuous Improvement & Reporting

  

  
* Operational Optimization: Proactively identify areas for improvement; plan and execute initiatives that enhance quality, boost productivity, and reduce operational costs.
  
* Solution Advisory: Collaborate with internal teams to evaluate trade-offs and recommend viable technical or process alternatives to management and stakeholders.
  
* Visibility & Reporting: Continuously monitor operational workflows to apply system modifications, while providing clear status reports and executive dashboards to the Director, Business Operations and senior leadership.
  

  
  

What You Bring

  

  
* ServiceNow Expertise (Mandatory): Proven, hands-on experience acting as a Business Analyst on ServiceNow implementations, with a deep understanding of the platform's workflows and capabilities.
  
* Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 1–2 years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing other BAs.
  
* Full-Lifecycle Delivery: Demonstrated track record owning BA deliverables across the entire system implementation lifecycle—from initial discovery and requirements gathering to process design, UAT coordination, and cutover.
  
* Documentation & Modeling: Expert ability to translate complex operational workflows into clear process maps, requirements documents, and actionable user stories.
  
* Process Governance: Demonstrated success in creating or standardizing BA frameworks, templates, and best practices from the ground up.
  
* Communication & Facilitation: Strong facilitation skills with the ability to run workshops, align conflicting stakeholder priorities, and present clear dashboards/updates to senior leadership.
  

  
  

You don't need to check every box. If you have strong experience, we’d love to hear from you.

  
  

Our Commitment to Inclusion

  

At Beanfield, we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams make stronger teams, and we want people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to feel welcome here.

  

We’re committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or any other protected status.

  

Beanfield provides reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process. If you need support during your application or interview, please contact recruitment@beanfield.com.

  

Important Information

  

Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance, and experience. The salary range indicated includes a Short Term Incentive Plan (“STIP”), which represents a percentage of base salary based on the achievement of individual and corporate objectives. STIP payments are subject to the plan's eligibility requirements and applicable performance measures.

Title: Director Information Technology

Our team of more than 1200 people work in environmental waste management and recovery, renewable energy, paving and construction, aggregates, and emulsions chemistries. We are seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking Director of Information Technology to lead our organization's technology strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and digital transformation initiatives. Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the organization's technology landscape, ensuring our systems, infrastructure, and digital capabilities support both current business operations and future growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic leader who can balance big-picture thinking with operational excellence. From strengthening our cybersecurity posture and modernizing enterprise systems to championing artificial intelligence and automation, you will help identify opportunities where technology can drive productivity, improve efficiencies, reduce costs, and create competitive advantages. Leading a talented team of 18 IT professionals, you will collaborate closely with executive leadership and business partners across the organization to develop and execute technology solutions that deliver measurable business value.

If you're passionate about innovation, thrive on solving complex challenges, and have the leadership skills to inspire high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you!

**Location:** Niagara Falls, Ontario
  
**Salary:** $160,000–$180,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications
  
**Reports To:** Executive Vice President, Finance & Chief Financial Officer
  
**Team Leadership:** 5 direct reports and 13 indirect reports

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and execute the IT strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring alignment with organizational business objectives and corporate strategic priorities.
* Partner with executive leadership and business unit managers to translate business needs into technology priorities, identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and business performance.
* Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and IT automation, to drive innovation, strengthen security, and enhance business operations.
* Oversee the architecture, implementation, and ongoing support of network, server, cloud, and communications infrastructure, ensuring reliability, availability, scalability, and security.
* Manage the organization's enterprise systems portfolio and IT service delivery, ensuring systems effectively support business processes, remain current, and provide reliable end-user support with measurable service standards.
* Advance the organization's AI strategy, including AI governance, responsible-use policies, and the implementation of AI tools and solutions that drive productivity improvements, procurement savings, sales growth, and pricing optimization.
* Establish and maintain data governance practices that ensure data quality, privacy, security, and accessibility to support reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives.
* Lead the organization's cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and policies, protecting organizational data, ensuring system availability, and overseeing incident response and risk management.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the IT team while overseeing IT budgets, capital and operational expenditures, technology projects, system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and vendor relationships.
* Provide quarterly updates to the Board Audit Committee on the progress and status of IT and cybersecurity initiatives, ensuring transparency, accountability, and alignment with organizational priorities.

**Here’s What You Need**

* A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with professional certifications such as CISSP, PMP, or ITIL considered an asset.
* Greater than 15 years experience in IT management, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
* A valid G Registration Ontario Driver’s Licence in good standing is required for this position.
* Extensive knowledge of IT infrastructure, enterprise systems, applications, cloud technologies, and technology architecture.
* Strong expertise in cybersecurity, network security, IT risk management, and compliance, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM, site-to-site connectivity, and remote access.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining disaster recovery, business continuity, and cybersecurity strategies to protect organizational assets and ensure operational resilience.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute IT strategies, lead complex technology projects, and drive digital transformation initiatives, including AI, automation, data analytics, and business intelligence.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to understand business processes, identify technology opportunities, and translate organizational priorities into practical, cost-effective solutions.
* Proven financial and vendor management experience, including developing IT budgets, overseeing technology investments, negotiating contracts, and managing external service providers.
Demonstrated leadership experience in recruiting, mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing IT teams, with exceptional communication, collaboration, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.  

**What’s in it for you**

* You become part of a team you can count on
* A comprehensive total rewards package and benefits to support your wellbeing
* Leaders who support your growth and success
* Flexible work policies and strong work-life balance
* Give back to our communities with two paid volunteer days annually and opportunities to become involved in events

At Walker, diversity, equity and inclusion are core values. We celebrate a culture that respects varied backgrounds and life experiences and actively encourage women and under-represented groups to apply and thrive here. We value a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

Walker Industries does not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants. Hiring decisions are made by qualified professionals to maintain a fair, human-led process.

Should you require any accommodation in applying for this role, or throughout the interview process, please let us know when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

Title: manager, release management (Global Experience Technology) Seattle, WA
Description:
This position contributes to Starbucks success by managing the production and delivery of technology solutions that drive business value. As a manager, release management, you will direct and manage application and system software and hardware releases, as well as plan and schedule deployments. This role develops and manages Release Management lifecycle processes across integrated products, applications and systems. Release Management initiates, scopes, controls, monitors, and deploys changes throughout the entire software development lifecycle. Models and acts in accordance with Starbucks guiding principles.

Summary of Key Responsibilities

Leadership

* Sets goals for the work group, develops organizational capability, and models how we work together.
