Title: Contact Center Manager
Description:
Trust is everything for financial institutions, but it gets harder to earn as customer expectations rise and fraud keeps evolving. At Casap, we’re on a mission to deliver outcomes that were once out of reach, building a future where fraud is rare and trust is a given.
  
  
We started with disputes, some of the highest-stakes work financial institutions can’t afford to get wrong, and have expanded the same approach across fraud, collections, claims and more. Today, more than 100 banks, credit unions, fintechs and processors trust our AI agents to make decisions, take actions, move money and file chargebacks, from first signal to final outcome.
  
  
Founded by product leaders from Robinhood and Chime, Casap has raised $90M, including a $56M Series B led by Base10 Partners with continued investment from Lightspeed and Emergence. We were named Tearsheet’s 2026 AI Company of the Year, and our CEO, Shanthi, was named to Inc.’s 2026 Female Founders 500. We have an exceptionally ambitious and kind culture, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Location(s)**
This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, CA office. Our team works in-office time on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Contact Center Manager to join our Managed Services team and oversee our BPO operations day to day. As Managed Services expands, our BPO engagement is the compliant, reliable entry point for every fintech and credit union client we support. You'll lead our outsourced contact center and back-office investigation teams, manage policies and procedures, optimize IVR routing and call scripts, and turn vendor partnerships into clear results for our clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own BPO Performance Day to Day: Serve as the primary operational contact for our contact center vendor(s). Manage SLA adherence, stand up performance reporting, run a regular vendor review cadence, and escalate underperformance with clear evidence and a path to resolution.
* Own IVR Design and Call Routing: Design, test, and optimize IVR flows and routing logic across vendor platforms. Reproduce routing issues, review call logs and data, and identify root cause before escalating to the vendor, engineering, or product.
* Own Scripting and Quality Standards: Partner with the QA/Performance Manager to build and maintain call scripts, quality standards, and calibration practices that keep every interaction compliant, consistent, and on-brand for each client.
* Partner on Workforce Management: Collaborate with WFM to align staffing, scheduling, and coverage planning with volume forecasts, and flag capacity risks before they affect clients.
* Own Security and Compliance for Phone Intake: Define and monitor controls for phone-based intake, including caller authentication and data handling. Audit the vendor against those controls and drive remediation of any gaps.
* Own Outcomes, Not Just Tickets: Treat recurring vendor or call-quality issues as programs to be solved. Define scope, align internal stakeholders and the vendor, and deliver durable resolutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Be the Bridge to Engineering and Product: Translate contact center and client friction into clear technical requirements and prioritized, business-context-rich input. Advocate for scalable solutions, including tooling integrations and automation.
* Optimize Contact Center Tooling: Partner with Managed Services Leadership on the integration and optimization of contact center platforms (e.g., TaskUs or equivalent).[C1]
* Support Client Relationships: Support the Vendor Ops Manager in client-facing work by providing performance data, preparing for business reviews, and connecting vendor results to each client’s operational goals.
* Drive Enablement and Documentation: Build the runbooks, escalation paths, and training materials that make the vendor self-sufficient and prevent repeat issues. Support the implementation team in standing up phone intake for new Managed Services clients.

**What You’ve Done**

* 4-7 years in contact center operations, vendor management, technical account management, or customer success, ideally at a B2B SaaS or fintech company serving financial institutions.
* Experience managing outsourced or in-house contact center operations at scale, ideally in a regulated industry, with hands-on IVR, WFM, and vendor SLA management.
* Experience in payments, disputes, chargebacks, or Reg E/Z compliance workflows, and familiarity with compliance requirements for phone-based financial services intake.
* A track record of turning vendor relationships into measurable, accountable performance.
* Ability to investigate issues independently: reviewing call data and logs, querying data, and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the presence to build credibility with vendor leadership and with operational and executive stakeholders at clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: able to make a complex operational or dispute issue clear to both frontline teams and leadership, and to work closely with QA, Product, and vendor partners.
* Structured problem-solver with great composure when an issue is live and the stakes are high, comfortable building process while doing the work in an early-stage environment.

Education
---------

* University degree in communications, public relations, journalism, health sciences or related discipline
* Master’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, health sciences or related discipline required.

Knowledge
---------

* Eight (8) years’ professional experience in issues management, internal communications, public relations, public affairs/relations, social marketing, community consultation and media relations; experience in public health or a health care setting is preferred

Responsibilities

Provides leadership and management direction to staff responsible for the external communications and engagement activities of the department. (30% of time)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Establishes the vision and strategy for communications and engagement to enable Public Health & Emergency Services to achieve its goal of impact on health and health equity

* Leads the development of Public Health & Emergency Services’ digital engagement and media relations strategies, conducting ongoing media relations activities for Public Health & Emergency Services, including preparing media products, organizing media conferences, and identifying and encouraging opportunities for positive media coverage
* Leads the development and implementation of Public Health & Emergency Services’ media relations program, which includes proactive and reactive engagement
* Works closely with municipal, provincial or federal communication counterparts to deliver joint announcements at media events or special events that involve or impact the Niagara Region
* Formulates and implements strategic communications plans to support Public Health & Emergency Services in building effective relationships with its external clients and stakeholders
* Monitors trends, issues and legislation that affect Public Health & Emergency Services or its stakeholders and recommends approaches or responses to address issues identified

* Ensures staff has the information and resources to make successful plans and decisions.
* Ensures all people related issues, including recruitment, grievances and labour relations issues, are aligned to HR and Corporate standards and practices.
* Helps to break down barriers to employee success, ensuring collaboration and cooperation with other teams within their division and department
* Ensures Occupational Health & Safety policies, programs and practices are implemented, and maintained. This includes workplace inspections, monitoring, accident reporting and investigations, and ensuring any observed hazards or lapses in the functioning of OH&S processes, and other OH&S concerns are responded to promptly.
* Ensures all individuals under supervision have been informed of hazards and instructed on the necessary risk control and emergency response measures;

Leads internal communications in Public Health. Enables Public Health & Emergency Services leadership with building engagement, supporting culture and disseminating information across all levels of Public Health through communication strategies, creative services employee engagement expertise. (20% of time)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Leads the development and implementation of communication plans and strategies to support strategic business and operational activities and ensure consistency in key messages
* Leads the Public Health & Emergency Services employee engagement activities through the development and implementation of the department’s internal communications strategy, identifying engagement opportunities for staff at all levels.
* Ensures the implementation and evaluation of relevant elements of the Public Health & Emergency Services strategic plan
* Participates in Senior Leadership Team meetings, advising the Medical Officer of Health, Associate Medical Officers of Health, the Public Health Chief of Staff, Chief of Emergency Medical Services, and Directors on strategic business decisions, and confidential or sensitive issues
* Ensure all policies and standards related to communications, community outreach, and employee engagement are successfully incorporated, understood, and communicated

---------------------------------------

  

At INEOS Styrolution & Aromatics we produce essential chemical building blocks and high-performance materials that shape modern life and support the products people rely on every day. Our portfolio includes purified terephthalic acid (PTA), paraxylene (PX), styrene monomer, polystyrene, ABS and advanced styrenics, serving a wide range of industries, including automotive, construction, electronics, healthcare, packaging, textiles, household and leisure.

Combining deep technical expertise, a broad portfolio and global reach with a strong local presence, we work closely with customers worldwide to create value and deliver innovative solutions that meet evolving needs.

As one of the world's leading chemical manufacturers, we are committed to safety, operational excellence and sustainability. Across manufacturing, engineering, technology and business functions, we create an environment where people and ideas thrive, offering opportunities to grow, make a meaningful impact and contribute to solutions that support customers, communities and a more sustainable future.

  

### **Current Opportunity**

#### **Job Title: Vice President Operations, Polymers - Americas** **Location: On site Bayport, Cooper River, Decatur, Altamira, Pasedena TX and Naperville office**

This role is an executive management position responsible for all of the manufacturing sites within the Americas region for Aromatics & Styrolution sites. This role provides leadership and direction to five manufacturing sites located in the United States and Mexico. * Identify opportunities to improve profitability, optimize resources, and strengthen the region's competitive position.

* Foster a culture of safety, continuous improvement, open communication, coaching, and trust.
* Ensure safe, compliant, and reliable manufacturing operations, with safety remaining the highest priority.

Manufacturing Excellence & Operational Leadership

* Establish and execute cost leadership initiatives, including cost optimization, budget management, and innovative procurement and contract strategies.
* Build and maintain the talent, technical expertise, and organizational capabilities required to sustain long-term operational performance.

Capital Investment & Project Management

* Oversee the execution of major capital projects, ensuring effective project governance and capital efficiency.

* Provide strategic guidance to Site Managers on complex supplier and contractor relationships, contractual matters, and operational partnerships.
* Leverage strong commercial and technical knowledge to manage third-party relationships, optimize contractual value, and support efficient site operations.
* Ensure effective coordination across manufacturing, logistics, energy, environmental, and other operational partners.

Global Operations Alignment

* Ensure the effective implementation of global operations strategies, initiatives, standards, and performance targets throughout the Americas region.
* Collaborate with global functional leaders and regional stakeholders to share best practices, drive consistency, and continuously improve operational performance.

  

**What You Will Bring:**

* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing large teams within a manufacturing or site-based environment.
* Extensive experience leading complex manufacturing operations, preferably across multiple sites.

* Demonstrated experience in operational strategy, financial and cost management, capital investment planning, and large-scale project execution.

* Ability to make sound, objective decisions under pressure while balancing competing operational and commercial priorities.
* Experience developing talent, building leadership capabilities, and establishing effective succession plans.

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  
  
Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  
  
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

As an Area Manager II at an Amazon fulfillment center, you'll act as a strategic leader overseeing upto 80 associates while driving department level operational improvements. Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
**\*\* This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office \*\***

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Delivery Management to lead a team of Delivery Managers who help product teams overcome obstacles and deliver effectively. You are accountable for your team's performance and for demonstrating how Delivery Management support improves delivery. You work with Product, Engineering, and internal partners to agree on meaningful measures of success, establish a starting point, and use results to guide action.

You are expected to notice problems and opportunities, speak up, and take action. Stay close to your Delivery Managers, Technology and Product leaders, and business partners to understand what is working and where teams need better support or tooling. Turn what you learn into clear actions informed by data and feedback, and follow through on your team's commitments.

Delivery Management works as part of the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org, which brings together delivery support, engineering practices, workflow capabilities, investment and capacity information, and performance insights. You involve the right leaders when a solution crosses functional or team boundaries.

Delivery Manager support may focus on a product area, a problem spanning several products or product groups, a mission team, or a High Integrity Commitment. You recognize where support will help and when it should change or end. Product Managers retain product and business responsibilities, Tech Leads retain technical decisions and delivery accountability, and product teams retain their commitments. Delivery Managers help reduce process and tooling inefficiencies that prevent teams from delivering effectively.

For example, a Delivery Manager identifies recurring delays. You bring together the appropriate leaders in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to examine the data and address the causes, which may involve automation or a new capability. The team and Delivery Manager assess whether delivery improves. You ensure actions have owners and unresolved issues reach the accountable leaders who can address them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Build and lead the team.** Lead recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and performance management. Set expectations for each Delivery Manager level, give regular feedback, and build development and succession plans. Encourage peer learning and share approaches that work, adapting practices to the problem. Recommend hiring, promotion, termination, and staffing decisions for supervisor review and approval.

**Set direction for your team.** Translate department priorities into team goals and work plans. Agree objectives with your supervisor and plan staffing, assignments, and development needs over the next 6-12 months. Review progress and adjust plans as needs change.

**Provide support where it adds value.** Work with Product and Engineering leaders to understand support needs. Match assignments to each Delivery Manager's experience, skills, and available capacity. Resolve competing requests within agreed priorities and staffing. Bring decisions about additional capacity or changes in direction to your supervisor.

**Make responsibilities clear.** Agree on the problems to address, support needed, expected results, and delivery success metrics with Product and Technology leaders and internal customers. Review results with those partners, your team, and your supervisor to determine whether more help is needed or support should move elsewhere, be reduced, or end. Coach Delivery Managers to spot problems early while leaving routine coordination with the teams and leads closest to the work.

**Own your team's results.** Set clear performance expectations for Delivery Managers and assess their effectiveness using agreed metrics and outcomes, supported by data and feedback from internal customers and Product and Engineering leaders. Challenge updates that describe activity without showing progress. Address signs that delivery support is becoming ongoing ownership of team ceremonies, routine project coordination, or project management office oversight. When work stalls, understand why, address the issue, and make sure the next action and owner are clear.

**Resolve issues that need leadership.** Help Delivery Managers address problems beyond their authority or experience. Bring the right decision-makers together and follow through on agreed actions. Handle day-to-day team decisions independently. Seek guidance on complex assignments, competing department priorities, or decisions beyond your authority; obtain supervisor approval for strategic decisions affecting team objectives.

**Turn recurring problems into shared improvements.** Use data and feedback to identify repeated delays and unnecessary effort. Challenge practices that are not helping and bring recommendations to leaders who own or are affected by the issue. Establish a starting point, then agree on improvement actions, owners, expected results, and timing. Follow through to determine whether changes helped, adjust when needed, and raise unresolved issues.

**Work as one organization.** Regularly speak with Product and Engineering leaders and your peers in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org. Understand where teams are succeeding and where support could help. Hold Delivery Managers accountable for sharing findings and opportunities and involving the appropriate leaders in solutions. Each functional leader retains ownership of their team's capabilities and tools.

**Coordinate Delivery Manager and Program Management support.** Work with Program Management leadership when assignments need sustained technical planning and coordination, including operational work or work outside the Product Operating Model. Make responsibilities clear when someone serves in a Delivery Manager or Program Management capacity, and when that assignment changes.

**Make delivery information reliable and useful.** Hold Delivery Managers accountable for working with teams and information owners to keep needed information accurate, current, and available in agreed tools such as Jira. Use existing information before asking for separate updates. Work with system owners and affected leaders when information is missing or hard to capture, find, or interpret. Partner with the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to establish consistent definitions, reliable data sources, and practical reporting for the agreed key performance indicators (KPIs). Ensure results are shared and reviewed with internal customers and appropriate leaders to guide decisions and improvement actions.

**Contribute to staffing and budget plans.** Contribute staffing and development needs to budget planning with the appropriate leaders in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org. Manage assignments within approved staffing and funding, and apply company policies consistently.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

***Employment Experience***

  

* At least 7 years of experience in delivery management, program management, or related software delivery roles, plus at least 2 years of staff-management experience.
* Experience hiring, coaching, reviewing performance, and developing delivery professionals supporting multiple product teams or product areas.
* Experience working with empowered product teams and understanding how Product Operating Model delivery support differs from operational or other program management.

***Technical Skills***

**Technical Acumen**

* Strong understanding of software delivery from discovery through development, release, and production support. Able to coach Delivery Managers and have useful conversations with engineering leaders. No coding required.
* Working knowledge of iterative and continuous delivery, technical dependencies, release readiness, and program coordination. Able to choose an approach that fits the work.
* Proficiency in Jira and Confluence. Able to explain information, workflow, and automation needs to tool owners and use delivery information to support decisions.

**AI & Agentic Delivery Practices**

* Effective use of everyday AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT for research, communication, analysis, and delivery work. Able to coach the team on responsible use.
* Understanding of AI-enabled and agentic delivery practices. Able to spot useful automation opportunities, assess whether they help, and support the team in learning new tools and practices.
* Working knowledge of AI-DLC practices and guardrails. Able to identify adoption problems and work with Engineering and the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org on improvements.

**Delivery Rigor, Lean Process & Flow Metrics**

* Experience setting team goals and work plans, balancing support demand and capacity, and matching assignments to people's skills.
* Experience using root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and flow measures such as cycle time, throughput, work in progress, and aging work to understand problems and assess improvements.
* Able to agree on meaningful KPIs with internal customers, partners, and the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to assess Delivery Manager effectiveness and demonstrate measurable delivery improvements.

***Additional Skills & Competencies***

* You've managed and developed delivery professionals. You can explain how your hiring, coaching, and performance decisions helped people work more effectively and independently.
* You take ownership. You raise concerns early, bring practical recommendations, and follow through. You are comfortable challenging an approach, having a difficult conversation, and holding people accountable for agreed actions.
* You understand empowered product teams and know when support will help and when it would take ownership away from their leaders.

**Job Summary**
The
**Operations Manager, Vendor Relations**
will be responsible for the strategic oversight, operational governance, and day-to-day contract management of RadNet’s third-party Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partnerships. This includes managing Statement of Work (SOW) compliance, operational performance, and quality delivery across nearshore and offshore contact center partners, specifically scheduling operations and offshore administrative and back-office operations.
  
  
This role serves as the primary operational liaison holding vendor leadership accountable to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), headcount adherence, and billing reconciliation. The Operations Manager will organize, lead, and drive all vendor governance meeting cadences (weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews), manage Corrective Action and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), and partner cross-functionally with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality Assurance (QA), IT/Telephony, and Regional Operations to ensure seamless patient experience and cost-efficient operational delivery.
  
  
**You Will**

* SOW & Contract Governance: Manage and enforce all operational terms, deliverables, obligations, and performance benchmarks defined within vendor Statements of Work (SOWs) and Master Services Agreements (MSAs) across all outsourced partners.
* Vendor Accountability & Performance Management: Hold vendor operational leadership strictly accountable for contractual KPIs including Inbound Average Handling Time (IAHT), Call Quality/QA scores, Idle Time, occupancy, adherence, Abandonment Rates, Average Schedule Rate, and Monthly Attrition thresholds (monthly).
* Offshore Administrative Operations Management: Oversee and manage the daily operational workflows, accuracy, turnaround times, and productivity of offshore back-office administrative teams supporting order entry, document administration, medical records requests, insurance validation support, and pre-service tasks.
* Governance Meeting Cadence Leadership: Organize, lead, and establish structured agendas for all recurring vendor governance sessions, including:

+ Weekly Operational & Performance/QC Reviews: Tactical review of SLAs, error trends, and immediate corrective action plans.
+ Weekly Quality Control Calibration: Joint calibration between RadNet and vendor quality teams to ensure consistent evaluation and scoring standards.
+ Weekly Workforce Management (WFM) & Staffing Reviews: Analysis of roster headcount adherence, schedule lock-in, intraday forecasting, and shrinkage mitigation.
+ Weekly Regional Operations Touchpoints: Alignment between regional contact center leaders and dedicated vendor pods.
+ Monthly KPI & Invoice Reconciliation: Audit of monthly billed hours against actual telephony dispositions, validation of penalty deductions, under-staffing fee reductions, and contractual service level credits.
+ Monthly Dedicated Training Reviews: Curriculum alignment, evaluation of nesting graduation rates, and planning for new skill/protocol rollouts.
+ Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR): High-level strategic review with executive leadership evaluating operational trends, capacity expansion, technology integration, and overall partnership health.

* Financial & Billing Auditing: Rigorously validate monthly vendor invoices against telephony data (Five9/telephony reports) and approved billable dispositions (Available, Production, Approved Meetings, Approved Nesting/Upskilling). Enforce under-staffing penalty credits, non-billable overages, and downtime limitations for platform outages or local vendor issues.
* Remediation & PIP Management: Identify operational bottlenecks, performance dips, or quality variances; mandate, evaluate, and monitor vendor-submitted Corrective Action Plans and formal Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) to swift resolution.
* Technology & Workflow Integration: Collaborate with internal IT, Telephony, and PMO teams to support vendor access, provisioning, and workflow execution across core RadNet platforms, including Five9 telephony, Salesforce P360, eRAD RIS, and secure enterprise workspaces.
* Training, Onboarding & Nesting Oversight: Partner with internal training teams to ensure vendor new-hire onboarding, 20-day "Ready State" certifications, attrition replacement training (at vendor expense), and compliance training are executed to RadNet standards prior to live production.
* Offshore Compliance & Data Security: Enforce strict adherence to HIPAA, protected health information (PHI) safeguards, ISO/HITRUST security standards, and offshore resource utilization policies in coordination with RadNet Information Security and Compliance.

**If You Are**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing offshore/nearshore vendor operations, including contact center scheduling teams and offshore administrative/back-office transaction processing.
* Proven track record of managing, enforcing, and interpreting vendor contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), SLA credit models, and invoice reconciliations.
* Understanding of contact center metrics, WFM scheduling principles (e.g., Calabrio, IEX, Verint), telephony platforms (e.g., Five9, Cisco), and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
* Exceptional leadership and facilitation skills with demonstrated ability to chair executive governance reviews, run multi-stakeholder operational meetings, and enforce accountability.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, modeling, variance analysis) and reporting dashboards.
* Strong written, verbal, and cross-cultural communication skills, with experience managing cross-border distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of patient (HIPAA/PHI) and enterprise proprietary data.

**Preferred**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing daily field execution, team performance, and service quality within assigned delivery teams. This role ensures that installations, de-installations, and deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with company standards.

The Delivery Manager leads frontline delivery personnel, reinforces operational discipline, and owns enforcement of safety, accident reporting, driver compliance, and company field policies.

The Delivery Manager reports to the Operations Manager or Senior Delivery Manager.

 **Requirements**  

**Operational Execution & Quality Assurance**
---------------------------------------------

* Direct daily loading, unloading, and installation operations to ensure optimal efficiency.
* Perform on-site quality audits to guarantee strict adherence to the company's installation standards.
* Uphold rigorous expectations for proper product handling, precise staging, and elevated in-home presentations.
* Champion the cross-training and comprehensive onboarding of all delivery personnel.

**Team Leadership & Personnel Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Provide direct supervision and leadership to delivery leads, drivers, and delivery helpers.
* Deliver constructive performance coaching and execute necessary corrective action discussions.
* Lead regular safety meetings to continuously reinforce operational and procedural discipline.
* Participate in the recruitment process, including conducting interviews and facilitating new hire onboarding.

**Delivery Operations & Logistics Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Guarantee the successful execution of all delivery schedules within established service windows.
* Validate routing readiness by ensuring optimal crew assignments and comprehensive job preparedness.
* Proactively triage and resolve field-level operational challenges to minimize formal escalations.

**Safety Protocol & Regulatory Compliance**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain strict adherence to Department of Transportation (DOT) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) regulations across all assigned teams.
* Enforce the company's mandatory accident reporting policies meticulously.
* Guarantee the immediate and accurate reporting and documentation of all vehicular and in-home incidents.
* Oversee the prompt submission of comprehensive accident reports, photographic evidence, and required witness statements.
* Implement necessary retraining programs and corrective actions following safety incidents.
* Manage driver qualification files to ensure absolute compliance for assigned teams.
* Verify that all essential documentation, including medical cards, Motor Vehicle Records (MVRs), road test results, and certifications, is fully up-to-date.
* Guarantee that all compliance records are accurately uploaded and maintained within designated company platforms.
* Immediately escalate any instances of regulatory or policy non-compliance.
* Enforce strict team adherence to all field reporting protocols and direct-to-site commuting guidelines.

**Fleet Readiness & Equipment Maintenance**
-------------------------------------------

* Continuously assess vehicle conditions and proactively report any required maintenance.
* Ensure all delivery trucks and associated equipment consistently meet professional standards and are fully prepared for daily operations.
* Verify the accurate and consistent completion of daily vehicle pre-trip inspections.

These duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work and are not an exhaustive list. The employee may be required to perform other duties as assigned.

**Required**
------------

* Proven experience leading frontline delivery personnel, including leads, drivers, and helpers.
* Hands-on ability to oversee daily field execution to ensure installations, de-installations, and deliveries are completed safely and efficiently.
* Strong working knowledge of DOT and OSHA regulations, with the ability to enforce safety standards at the team level.
* Experience managing driver compliance files, including medical cards, MVRs, road tests, and relevant certifications.
* Capable of enforcing accident reporting procedures, ensuring proper documentation, and implementing corrective retraining when necessary.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct site visits for quality control and enforce high standards for product handling and in-home presentation.
* Background in fleet oversight, specifically monitoring vehicle condition, reporting maintenance needs, and verifying daily pre-trip inspections.
* Excellent problem-solving skills required to triage field-level issues and prevent larger escalations.
* Strong communication skills necessary for conducting performance coaching, facilitating safety meetings, and supporting onboarding efforts.

* Life insurance.
* Opportunity to work with a passionate and dynamic team.
* Career growth and development opportunities.

Delivery Managers keep Vesta field teams safe, compliant, and on schedule.

* Willingness to travel in service of renewals and account management, up to 50% of time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in renewable energy, especially solar

Responsible for coordinating and integrating intra-hospital services. Ensures division has qualified staff and needed resources in order to deliver safe quality care and outcomes. Establishes performance standards with which to measure effectiveness and efficiency of services. Drives the establishment of performance metrics, service benchmarks, and quality assurance initiatives within IT Service Delivery. Implements continuous service improvement processes based on user feedback, data analytics, and ServiceNow reporting
  
  
System Thinking ;Competency: a) Ability to see how individual actions contribute to the overall good of the institution. Skillful at reconciling the two without sacrificing the critical needs of either. Accountability: Works collaboratively with a variety of key stakeholders to achieve team, department and YRMC’s goals. Demonstrates an ability to align departmental goals with the larger vision of Onvida Health. Understands how IT Service Delivery operations impact clinical, operational, and administrative workflows across the organization.
  
  
Human Resources Management Competency: a) Able to develop others through setting clear expectations, mentoring and coaching, and holding others accountable for results. b) Utilizing work force analysis, identifies required competencies needed for effective management of human resources and is able to identify short and long-term staffing needs, c) Conducts oneself in an honest, credible, trustworthy manner consistent with YRMC’s values. Demonstrates an integration of values, beliefs, attitudes and behaviors through an acceptance of responsibility and accountability for individual’s own actions.
  
  
Accountability: Ensures that the work force has the necessary skills to accomplish the work required to achieve the objectives of the department. Partners with Human Resources to develop long-term human resource plans, anticipating future needs and developing employees able to meet those challenges. Fosters an open working environment for easy access to express ideas and concerns. Demonstrates and expects open communications. Leads workforce development efforts by mentoring, coaching, and providing clear career progression pathways for Service Desk and Field Services staff. Partners with HR to forecast staffing needs based on service demands and future technologies.
  
  
Community ;Competency: a) Leverage the unique system capabilities (hospital and community providers) to increase value for external and internal customers and eliminate barriers to care. b) Participate in community involvement. c) Champion community involvement in the department and throughout the organization. Accountability: Promote and encourage community involvement throughout the department. Incorporate community goals in overall departmental goals. Essential:
